Title: Senior Design Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Design Manager to lead design initiatives for defense projects in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will oversee the design strategy, execution, and delivery of complex defense systems and components. You will manage cross-functional teams, ensure compliance with stringent defense industry standards, and drive innovation while maintaining the highest levels of precision and security. This position offers the opportunity to shape cutting-edge defense solutions and lead a talented group of design professionals.

* Lead and manage the design team, providing strategic direction, mentorship, and performance feedback to ensure excellence and professional development
* Oversee the complete design lifecycle for defense projects, from concept development through final delivery, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards
* Develop and implement design strategies that align with project objectives, regulatory requirements, and organizational goals
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation, and risk mitigation to ensure successful project completion within scope and schedule
* Ensure all designs comply with defense industry standards, international regulations, and UAE-specific security and compliance requirements
* Collaborate with stakeholders, including engineering, procurement, and client representatives, to define requirements and resolve design challenges
* Conduct design reviews and quality assurance checks to maintain technical excellence and identify areas for continuous improvement
* Analyze complex technical problems and provide innovative solutions that balance performance, cost, and manufacturability
* Maintain detailed documentation and design records in accordance with defense sector protocols and security guidelines
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in defense design and project management

  
**Qualifications**  

* Minimum 12 years of professional experience in design management, senior design roles, or equivalent leadership positions within the defense industry
* Proven expertise in managing large-scale, complex defense projects from conception through delivery
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, or a related field
* Must be an Arabic speaker

  
**Additional Information**

*At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.* ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Title: Senior Digital Project Engineer
Description:
Location: Doha, Qatar
  
  
Work Schedule: Standard office hours, 5 days a week.
  
  
**Job Purpose & Key Accountabilities**

* The Senior Digital Project Engineer in Conceptualisation shapes digital ideas into clear, viable, and delivery-ready initiatives. The role combines business analysis, stakeholder engagement, technical understanding, and digital consulting capabilities to help business teams define problems, assess opportunities, and prepare initiatives for successful delivery.
* The role leads and oversees early-stage discovery, requirements gathering, process and data analysis, value and cost framing, conceptualisation, definition of ready (DoR) assurance, and structured handover into use case delivery teams. This includes overseeing conceptualisation activities performed by third parties, ensuring that work progresses to plan, the appropriate activities are completed, stakeholders are engaged, and deliverables meet company and department quality and governance standards.
* The role also stewards the Digital idea backlog, ensuring opportunities are visible, prioritised, progressed, and governed through a consistent framework.
* The role requires sufficient Oil & Gas engineering, operational, and technical understanding to engage credibly with subject matter experts and assess engineering-focused opportunities while remaining capable of supporting digital opportunities across other business domains.

**Job Dimensions**

* Initiative Responsibility: Leads and oversees several opportunities at different maturity levels, from initial screening through to delivery handover, ensuring progress, quality, and alignment with the conceptualisation process.
* Facilitation and Coordination: Facilitates workshops, drives cross-functional discussions, aligns stakeholders, and coordinates Conceptualisation activities across business and DBS teams.
* Stakeholder Management: Engages a broad range of stakeholders across business entities, digital, DBS, and third parties. Builds relationships, manages expectations, resolves ambiguities, and navigates organisational processes to progress opportunities through the Digital lifecycle.
* Process Navigation and Governance: Maintains a strong understanding of company and department governance, demand management, procurement, cybersecurity, architecture, data governance, and delivery processes to ensure opportunities are progressed efficiently and through the appropriate pathways.
* Financial Responsibility: Develops and maintains initiative business cases, including cost estimation, income/spend forecasts, value assessments, and funding assumptions.
* Third-Party Oversight: Oversees Conceptualisation activities delivered by service contractors, ensuring agreed activities, milestones, and deliverables are completed on time and to the required quality. Reviews contractor outputs, provides direction and challenge, and ensures work remains aligned with company business needs, department processes, and delivery readiness requirements.

**Key Activities**

* Safety

+ Demonstrate the company Incident Free culture and HSE leadership behaviours.
+ Ensure project activities, deployments, and third-party work comply with all HSE guidelines.
+ Maintain psychologically safe team environments and promote transparent communication.
+ Ensure digital solutions contribute positively to safety and risk reduction.

* Cybersecurity

+ Apply the company's cyber security policies and department security standards to all project phases.
+ Coordinate cyber risk assessments, security architecture reviews, and threat modelling.
+ Ensure correct identity/access management, data handling, and data classification compliance.
+ Ensure vendors and partners meet NOC’s cybersecurity and data governance expectations.

* Opportunity Identification, Conceptualisation & Business Analysis

+ Act as a structured entry point for digital ideas and opportunities, supporting evaluation, prioritisation, and progression through the conceptualisation lifecycle.
+ Lead discovery activities with business stakeholders to understand problems, processes, pain points, data requirements, risks, constraints, and desired outcomes.
+ Facilitate workshops, interviews, and analysis activities to define business requirements, user needs, scope, value drivers, and success criteria.
+ Challenge assumptions, evaluate solution options, and assess process, data, technology, and organisational alternatives.
+ Coordinate Conceptualisation activities and prepare key deliverables including framing documents, requirements, value cases, roadmaps, prioritised functionality, and scopes of work.
+ Maintain visibility of the Conceptualisation portfolio and provide reporting on progress, priorities, dependencies, and resource demand.

* Delivery Readiness, Governance & Stakeholder Management

+ Coordinate Definition of Ready (DoR) activities and ensure initiatives meet agreed readiness and governance requirements prior to delivery.
+ Engage and align stakeholders across business entities, digital, DBS, and external partners to ensure initiatives progress effectively.
+ Navigate the company and department processes, including demand management, architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, procurement, and delivery governance.
+ Identify risks, issues, dependencies, and gaps, escalating where required.
+ Facilitate structured handover to delivery teams and support transition activities as required.
+ Prepare updates and reporting for management, governance forums, and steering committees.

* Third-Party Oversight and Quality Assurance

+ Define and communicate the expected scope, activities, deliverables, milestones, and quality standards for third-party-led conceptualisation work.
+ Oversee progress against agreed plans and ensure the appropriate discovery, analysis, stakeholder engagement, and governance activities are completed.
+ Review and challenge Conceptualisation outputs to ensure they accurately reflect business needs, technical context, requirements, value, costs, risks, and dependencies.
+ Provide direction and feedback, addressing delays, quality concerns, scope gaps, and unresolved decisions through corrective action or escalation.
+ Ensure outputs produced by third parties meet the definition of 'ready' requirements and provide a complete, coherent, and usable handover to Delivery.

* Costing, Value & Commercial Support

+ Develop and maintain cost estimates, forecasts, value assessments, and funding assumptions throughout the conceptualisation lifecycle.
+ Lead business case development, demand reviews, planning activities, and procurement processes.
+ Coordinate with Finance, Cost Control, Contracts and Procurement, delivery teams, and vendors to validate estimates, assumptions, and commercial inputs.
+ Maintain visibility of budget, commitment, forecast, and cost-related information for assigned initiatives, escalating risks and variances where appropriate.
+ Support Contracts and Procurement to review and challenge vendor proposals, effort estimates, and resource assumptions to support informed decision-making and investment prioritisation.

**Qualifications, Experience & Skills - Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in petroleum engineering, data science, computer science, or information systems.

+ Business Analysis, Project Management, Agile, or Change Management certification is preferred.

* Minimum Experience

+ Minimum 6 years’ experience in digital product development, digital transformation, or engineering/technology-enabled improvement.
+ Demonstrated success delivering digital products, ideally in the energy or industrial sector.
+ Experience in digital transformation within O&G is highly desirable.
+ Demonstrated experience working with engineering, operational, and technical stakeholders to understand complex requirements and shape digital or technology-enabled solutions.
+ Experience within Oil & Gas, energy, industrial, or other asset-intensive environments is highly desirable.
+ Experience overseeing work performed by third parties, service contractors, or multidisciplinary delivery partners, including reviewing progress, quality, and deliverables.

* Technical & Job Specific Skills

+ Ability to engage effectively with both business and technical stakeholders, translating operational needs into structured digital opportunities and requirements.
+ Sufficient understanding of engineering, operational, and business processes, with the ability to rapidly develop domain knowledge and challenge assumptions constructively.
+ Strong understanding of modern digital delivery practices, including Agile methodologies, SDLC, and product-based delivery.
+ Familiarity with cloud and digital platforms (e.g., Azure) and enterprise technology landscapes.
+ Experience with collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Azure DevOps.
+ Understanding of data platforms and digital ecosystems (e.g., OSDU, Cognite Data Fusion, data lakes, and analytics platforms).
+ Awareness of AI, generative AI, automation, and data-driven solutions, with the ability to identify opportunities and assess applicability to business challenges.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with attention to detail.
+ Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
+ Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
+ Ability to influence, challenge constructively, and build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
+ Fluent in English.

Title: Travel eSim Lead
Description:
Role Overview

The successful candidate will lead the Travel eSIM business end-to-end, developing and launching a competitive global Travel eSIM proposition targeting tourists, transit passengers and UAE-based international travellers.

The role combines commercial strategy, product development, digital customer experience, strategic partnerships and full P&L ownership, with responsibility for driving business growth and market competitiveness.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the Travel eSIM strategy, business case development, product design, launch and ongoing commercial growth.
* Own P&L performance, including revenue generation, margins, pricing strategy, customer acquisition and retention.
* Develop and optimise digital sales channels and customer journeys across e-commerce platforms, mobile applications, websites and WhatsApp.
* Establish and manage strategic partnerships with global eSIM providers, airlines, airports, travel companies and other distribution partners.
* Lead cross-functional teams across Product, IT, Digital, Marketing, Finance and Customer Care to ensure successful product delivery and operational excellence.
* Monitor global Travel eSIM competitors, market trends and customer insights to continuously enhance the product proposition.
* Identify new commercial opportunities, distribution channels and partnerships to expand market reach and profitability.

Candidate Requirements

* 10–15 years of relevant experience in telecommunications, digital products, international roaming, Travel eSIM, MVNO/MNO partnerships or consumer digital services.
* Strong understanding of the global Travel eSIM market and its competitive landscape, including providers.
* Proven experience launching, scaling and commercially managing digital products or propositions, with direct P&L ownership.
* Strong commercial negotiation, strategic partnership management and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
* Experience developing digital customer journeys, e-commerce platforms, customer acquisition strategies and conversion optimisation.
* Strong understanding of international connectivity, roaming propositions and global distribution models.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Telecommunications or a related discipline. An MBA would be advantageous.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A senior commercial or product leader currently working, at a telecom operator, global Travel eSIM provider or digital connectivity business.

The ideal candidate will have direct experience in Travel eSIM or international roaming propositions, with a strong track record of launching and growing commercially successful digital connectivity products.

Title: Head Of WPS and GPSSA

· Establish strong internal controls for WPS and GPSSA operations.

· Monitor operational KPIs and risk indicators.

· Ensure maker-checker controls are consistently followed.

· Investigate operational incidents and implement corrective actions.

* **Team Leadership**

· Lead, mentor, and develop the WPS & GPSSA Operations team.

· Conduct performance evaluations and training programs.

· Build a high-performance, customer-focused operational culture.

· Allocate resources to ensure business continuity.

* **Reporting & MIS**

· Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational dashboards.

· Present management reports covering:

· WPS volumes

· GPSSA transactions

· Processing accuracy

· Customer service metrics

· Operational risks

· Compliance status

· Provide business insights and recommendations to senior management.

* **Process Improvement**

· Drive digital transformation initiatives.

· Review and redesign workflows for greater efficiency.

· Participate in system implementations, testing, and new product launches.

· Recommend operational improvements to reduce costs and enhance customer experience.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Banking, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Professional certifications in Operations, Compliance, Risk Management, or Project Management are an advantage.
* 8–12 years of experience in UAE banking or exchange house operations.
* At least 5 years in a managerial or leadership role.
* Strong experience in WPS operations within an Exchange House.
* Hands-on experience with GPSSA operations and employer services.

Note: Only candidates who are available to join immediately will be shortlisted.  
They may also share their CV to careers@lm-exchange.com directly.

Work Location: In person

Title: Marketplace Operations & Partnerships Manager

Title: Test & Commissioning Manager (Qatar-based, 6-month contract, extendable)
Description:
**Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Test & Commissioning Manager to own the end-to-end testing lifecycle of complex, multi-domain technology programmes. The role covers test strategy, planning, execution and go-live readiness across software, AI, infrastructure, network, OT/SCADA and cybersecurity, while coordinating internal teams, customers and third-party vendors. This is a hands-on leadership position requiring strong technical breadth and customer-facing delivery experience.

* Define and maintain the test and commissioning strategy, master test plan, schedule, entry/exit criteria, environments and reporting cadence
* Lead test planning and execution across system integration, UAT, operational readiness, performance, resilience, security and commissioning
* Run workshops with technical leads and customers to define requirements, acceptance criteria, operational scenarios and test cases
* Coordinate test resources, environments, data, tools and vendors; manage risks, issues, defects and retesting through to closure
* Establish quality gates, requirements traceability and sign-off packs; provide go/no-go recommendations based on readiness and residual risk
* Manage and coach test engineers and specialist partners, ensuring consistent methods and documentation quality
* Coordinate VAPT activities across remote sites, on-premises, cloud and applications, including evaluation and selection of third-party testing vendors

* AI: LLM testing, ML model validation, video analytics testing
* Performance: load, stress and reliability testing (Master SCADA/OT, web applications, Azure)
* Network & WAN: NOC testing, passive and active ICT infrastructure
* IT infrastructure: monitoring solutions and service deployment validation
* Cybersecurity: VAPT management

**Qualifications/Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field (equivalent experience considered)
* 8+ years in testing, QA, systems integration or commissioning, including 3+ years leading complex test programmes or teams
* Proven ownership of end-to-end test strategy and execution across multiple technical domains, ideally in enterprise, public-sector, critical infrastructure, OT/SCADA or large-scale cloud environments
* Strong test management, defect management, requirements traceability, risk-based testing and sign-off experience
* Working knowledge of API, web, cloud, performance, network, infrastructure and cybersecurity testing, with the ability to lead domain specialists
* Experience working with customers, system integrators and third-party vendors in structured delivery programmes
* Excellent communication, workshop facilitation, prioritisation and decision-making skills

*Preferred:*

* Certifications: ISTQB Advanced Test Manager, ISEB, PMI, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum; security certification such as CISSP, CISM or CEH
* Azure testing, CI/CD, test automation and tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Postman, JMeter, LoadRunner, k6
* AI/ML evaluation, LLM risk controls, computer vision/video analytics or responsible AI assurance
* OT/SCADA, NOC operations, ICT infrastructure, VAPT coordination or regulated/mission-critical environments

Title: Network Operations Center (NOC) Lead - Damascus Based
Description:
**Position Objective:**

Define and govern the NOC operating model, ensuring all front-office monitoring and L1 support functions across the fiber network, Core, IT (ITOC), and IXP domains are fully designed, staffed, tooled, and validated ahead of Day-1 launch. Post-launch, the role transitions to governing the MSP NOC function.

**Job Description & Responsibilities:**

Define the NOC operating model —structure, monitoring scope, support processes, shift model, and escalation matrix.

Define monitoring requirements — latency, jitter, packet loss, and availability thresholds triggering alarms, auto-tickets, and escalation.

Define fault management framework — alarm handling/correlation, fault classification, prioritization, ticket creation, TAC escalation, threshold requirements across all monitored domains.

Define the NOC interface to the change management process — planned maintenance visibility, change freeze enforcement, and network change impact monitoring.

Define NOC tooling requirements including OSS, NMS, EMS, monitoring platforms, and real-time dashboard specifications.

Define the interface model between the NOC, TAC, field teams, SecOC, Application Services, and MSPs.

Define NOC procedures for carrier peering and interconnection monitoring across international exchange points and subsea landing stations.

Define NOC KPIs, SLA requirements, and performance reporting framework.

Define staffing levels, skills requirements, and training framework for NOC operators across all domains.

Govern NOC readiness validation — oversee simulations, dry runs, and acceptance criteria sign-off.

Participate in cross-functional OAT (Operational Acceptance Testing) to validate end-to-end NOC readiness for Day-1 launch.

Define the IXP operating model — route server management procedures, peering policy governance, BGP fault handling, and member onboarding interface with the NOC.

**Qualifications & Experience**
:

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related discipline.

Minimum 10 years in telecommunications network operations, with significant NOC leadership experience.

Strong experience designing or leading a NOC function in a carrier or wholesale infrastructure environment.

Experience defining alarm management frameworks and NOC tooling requirements across converged network and IT environments.

Greenfield or build-to-operate program experience is preferred.

Strong knowledge of NOC operations, monitoring methodologies, and alarm management across network and IT domains.

Experience with IXP operations including route server management, BGP monitoring, and peering policy governance.

Familiarity with NMS/EMS platforms, IT monitoring tools, and ITSM systems.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Strong written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is an advantage.

Experience with MSP governance, vendor performance management, and continual service improvement in NOC operations.

Title: Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing
Description:
We seek an individual inspired by our mission, whose beliefs align with our core values of integrity, inquiry, compassion and courage, and who reflects our core competencies to join our Upper School as **Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing** beginning in August 2027. This is a full-time position.

Salary range: $124,000 to $165,000. The total compensation for this Assistant Head position is based on placement on the Havergal College faculty grid plus a $20,000 leadership stipend (included in the above salary range). Grid placement is determined by teaching qualifications and experience up to a maximum of 11 years. Final placement within the range is based on the successful candidate's credentials and years of experience.

**Why Teach with Us**

At Havergal College, we believe that our strength lies in our faculty and staff's collective efforts, talents, and accomplishments. Together, we can make a positive and lasting impact on our students' lives.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package for teachers, including a faculty teaching grid that is well above the major urban school boards; contributions to and participation in the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan and/or Group RSP; generous holidays that allow employees to recharge; comprehensive health and dental benefits; support for professional development including support for graduate work, additional qualifications (AQs), faculty-wide and individual professional development in teaching and learning, wellbeing, equity and inclusion, assessment, and experiential education; and teaching on a beautiful 22-acre campus with excellent facilities.

**Why Havergal is the Place to Be**

Founded in 1894 and located on a beautiful 22-acre campus in midtown Toronto, Canada, Havergal College is one of Canada’s pre-eminent independent schools for girls from Junior Kindergarten through Grade 12.

At Havergal College, we believe great schools are made up of great people. With a rich history spanning over 130 years, we are committed to offering a contemporary liberal arts education rooted in the Anglican tradition. Our mission is to prepare young women to make a difference. Through our outstanding academic and co-curricular programs and a cohesive, collegial team of faculty and administrative staff, we nurture a culture of capability that fosters self-confidence, leadership, critical thinking, and global-mindedness in our students.

We take pride in attracting and retaining highly qualified faculty and administrative staff to ensure our school remains at the forefront of educational excellence. Join us in this transformative education journey, working together to empower young women to make a positive difference in our world.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that an inclusive environment fosters a culture of mutual respect, creativity and innovation, collaboration and accountability. To this end, we encourage applications from all qualified candidates with diverse experiences and perspectives, including women, BIPOC (Black, Indigenous and People of Colour) peoples, LGBTQ2S+, and persons with disabilities to join our thriving team. We seek candidates committed to nurturing a community where integrity, compassion, inquiry and courage thrive.

**The Position:**

The Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing provides operational leadership for student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12. Working collaboratively with the Upper School Leadership Team, this role ensures that every student is known, valued, and cared for, and has access to the relationships, resources, and support necessary to thrive academically, socially, and emotionally.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing oversees the integrated work of Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role. Through the leadership and development of these teams, the Assistant Head establishes a coordinated and responsive approach to student support that promotes belonging, engagement, inclusion and student success.

Guided by Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing, the Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing leads proactive and preventative approaches to wellbeing across the Upper School, building the capacity of faculty and staff to support students and ensuring effective systems are in place to identify and respond to emerging student needs.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing reports directly to the Head of Upper School and is accountable for fostering a safe, equitable and inclusive school culture aligned with Havergal's mission and values. This is a faculty leadership position requiring teaching qualifications and experience in an educational setting.

**Specific Accountabilities:**

**Leadership of Student Support & Wellbeing**

* Lead the development, implementation and ongoing evaluation of a comprehensive, coordinated approach to student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12, aligned with Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing.
* Champion proactive, preventative, strengths-based and evidence-informed approaches to wellbeing that promote student belonging, resilience, engagement and healthy development.
* Identify emerging trends in student wellbeing and learning needs, using relevant data, research and professional expertise to inform priorities, programming and resource allocation.
* Partner with the Assistant Heads of Middle and Senior Divisions and the Director of Boarding to ensure that wellbeing priorities are meaningfully embedded in the student experience, including Form, Teacher Advisor, grade-level and Boarding programming.
* Build faculty and staff capacity through professional learning and shared practices that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive education and effective responses to student needs.
* Contribute to school-wide strategic initiatives that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive excellence and the overall student experience.

**Leadership and Oversight of Student Support Services**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role.
* Lead, coach and develop Student Support leaders and team members, fostering professional growth, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities and communication practices across Student Support services to ensure an integrated and effective approach to student care.
* Oversee the effective allocation of staffing, resources and budgets across Student Support services.
* Ensure the effective delivery and continuous improvement of student support services, promoting responsive, accessible and coordinated support that meets the evolving needs of students and families.
* Provide leadership for Learning Support practices, ensuring effective systems for accommodations, Individual Education Plans and appropriate academic interventions.
* Champion the development of executive functioning skills, learning strategies and student self-advocacy in collaboration with academic leaders and faculty.
* Promote effective transitions for students entering, moving through and graduating from the Upper School, with particular attention to students requiring additional support.

**Coordinated Student Care and Intervention**

* Lead the development and implementation of effective systems for identifying, assessing, supporting and monitoring students experiencing academic, social, emotional, behavioural or health-related challenges.
* Oversee the Upper School Student Support Team, ensuring effective multidisciplinary collaboration, clear processes for case management and appropriate follow-through.
* Establish consistent protocols for student referrals, documentation, communication, intervention planning and escalation of concerns.
* Provide leadership and consultation in complex student support matters, working closely with Student Support professionals, divisional Assistant Heads and the Head of Upper School.
* Ensure that student support planning reflects appropriate professional expertise, confidentiality, safeguarding responsibilities and relevant school policies.
* Partner with families and external professionals, as appropriate, to coordinate student care and support successful school engagement.
* Oversee processes for student re-entry and reintegration following health-related leaves or other circumstances requiring coordinated support.

**Collaborative and Engaged Member of the Upper School Leadership Team**

* Serve as an active member of the Upper School Leadership Team, collaborating with divisional Assistant Heads, the Director of Boarding, Academic Leadership and Student Life leaders to advance shared priorities for student learning, wellbeing and engagement.
* Provide advice to the Head of Upper School on emerging student support needs, complex cases, resource priorities and opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute to the ongoing review and development of relevant school policies, procedures, the Family Handbook and communications relating to student support and wellbeing.
* Support Admissions in reviewing prospective applicants with IEPs or social-emotional needs.

**Qualifications, Knowledge and Experience**

* A recognized teaching qualification and membership in good standing with the Ontario College of Teachers (OCT), or equivalent qualifications and eligibility for OCT certification.
* Demonstrated teaching experience in a school setting, preferably with students in Grades 7–12.
* Experience in educational leadership, student support, Guidance, Learning Support or a related area of school-based practice.
* Deep understanding of the developmental, academic, social and emotional needs of students in Grades 7–12.
* Demonstrated knowledge of contemporary approaches to student wellbeing, mental health promotion, inclusive education and coordinated student support.
* Familiarity with the priorities and contemporary approaches within a girls' school.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, including the ability to lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary teams and foster a collaborative, accountable team culture.
* Sound professional judgement, discretion and problem-solving ability, particularly in navigating complex and sensitive student and family matters.
* Strong understanding of safeguarding, confidentiality, professional boundaries and appropriate student support and intervention practices.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and organizational skills, with the ability to build trusting relationships, think strategically and manage competing priorities.
* Leadership qualifications are an asset.
* Demonstrated ability and commitment to the Core & Leadership Competencies of:
  + Inclusive Excellence
  + Collaboration & Teamwork
  + Integrity & Trust
  + Learning Agility
  + Communication
  + Growth Mindset
  + Coach & Develop Others
  + Managerial Courage
  + Champion Change & Innovation
  + Purpose Alignment & Results

**How to Apply**

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply and express their interest to HC Careers no later than **December 1,** **2026.** *This posting is for an existing vacancy. We use an AI transcription tool for note-taking during the initial telephone pre-screening. This helps us capture key details, with Human Resources maintaining full oversight and final determination on all records. Candidate consent will be requested before the call, and declining will not affect your application. If declined, an HR member will take manual notes.*

Havergal College thanks all applicants in advance. Only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Havergal College is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process, and work environment in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). We will be happy to work with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process. If you require accommodations, please contact Cathy LeBlanc at 416-483-3519 ext. 6526 or by email at accessibility@havergal.on.ca.

Title: Night Duty Assistant Front Office Manager
Description:
Job Description – Night Duty Assistant Manager

Department: Front Office  
Reports To: Front Office Manager / Rooms Division Manager / Hotel Manager  
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose

The Night Duty Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall hotel operations during the night shift, ensuring smooth and efficient service delivery, guest satisfaction, safety, security, and compliance with hotel standards and company policies.

The role serves as the senior management representative on duty during nighttime hours, handling guest concerns, managing operational issues, supervising night staff, and ensuring the hotel operates efficiently in the absence of daytime management.

Key Responsibilities1. Hotel Operations Management

* Ensure proper handover from the evening team to the morning team.
* Make operational decisions in the absence of senior management.

2. Guest Relations and Customer Service

* Welcome VIP guests and ensure special attention is provided where required.
* Handle guest complaints, requests, and service recovery professionally.
* Ensure high levels of guest satisfaction throughout the night.
* Follow up on unresolved guest issues and ensure appropriate corrective action.
* Maintain a visible management presence in the hotel.

3. Front Office and Night Audit

* Supervise night reception and front office activities.
* Ensure smooth check-in and check-out procedures.
* Monitor room availability, occupancy, room status, and arrivals.
* Ensure the night audit is completed accurately and on time.
* Review daily reports, financial transactions, and operational discrepancies.
* Ensure proper cash handling and compliance with financial procedures.
* Process Front Office Duty Roster and other Front Office related works

4. Security and Safety

* Ensure the safety and security of guests, employees, and hotel property.
* Conduct regular security and safety inspections.
* Monitor incidents, unusual activities, and emergency situations.
* Ensure compliance with fire safety, health and safety, and emergency procedures.
* Act as the incident coordinator during emergencies until the relevant senior management or emergency services take over.
* Complete incident reports and escalate serious matters immediately.

5. Team Management and Supervision

* Supervise and support all employees working during the night shift.
* Ensure adequate staffing and effective allocation of duties.
* Monitor employee attendance, grooming, conduct, and performance.
* Motivate team members and maintain a professional working environment.
* Address operational and staff-related issues appropriately.
* Ensure proper communication and handover between shifts.

6. Financial and Administrative Responsibilities

* Monitor overnight revenue and financial transactions.
* Ensure accurate completion of daily revenue and night audit reports.
* Investigate discrepancies and report irregularities.
* Ensure compliance with company financial controls and procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, guest complaints, and operational activities.

7. Reporting and Communication

* Prepare and submit the Night Manager's Daily Report.
* Communicate important operational updates to the Hotel Manager and relevant department heads.
* Highlight maintenance issues, guest concerns, security incidents, and outstanding matters.
* Ensure a detailed handover to the morning management team.

Qualifications and Experience

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in hospitality management, Hotel Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in hotel operations, preferably in a supervisory or management position.
* Previous experience as a Duty Manager, Night Manager, or Assistant Front Office Manager is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of front office operations, night audit, and hotel management systems.
* Knowledge of hotel health, safety, security, and emergency procedures.
* Experience in handling guest complaints and managing operational challenges.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Excellent guest relations and conflict-resolution skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
* Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and hotel PMS systems.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Night Duty Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Guest satisfaction and complaint resolution.
* Smooth and efficient overnight hotel operations.
* Accuracy and timely completion of night audit.
* Compliance with company policies and operational standards.
* Security, safety, and incident management.
* Staff supervision and performance.
* Quality of daily reports and shift handovers.
* Reduction of operational errors and financial discrepancies.

Authority and Accountability

The Night Duty Assistant Manager is authorized to:

* Make operational decisions during the night shift.
* Handle guest complaints and approve service recovery within company guidelines.
* Coordinate all departments and allocate available resources.
* Take immediate action in emergency situations.
* Escalate major financial, security, guest-related, or operational matters to senior management.

Overall Accountability: To ensure the hotel front office operates safely, efficiently, and professionally throughout the night, while maintaining the company's service standards, protecting its assets, and delivering an excellent guest experience.

Pay: AED2,500.00 - AED3,500.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Responsibilities**

* **Operations**

* Provides administrative and/or clinical oversight and direction to the program areas of responsibility working collaboratively and cooperatively across the agency to create an integrated operational service.
* Oversees clinical accountability for Key Performance Indicators and reporting compliance to funders using data dashboards and other reporting tools.

Title: Customer Service Manager

Farmers Depot is under the GVF Group umbrella and operates in close affiliation with Grand Valley Fortifiers and Fortified Nutrition Limited. Whether through our charitable work, or our dedication to staff, GVF is committed to living out our principles and values.

  

**Why we have this role:**

  

At Farmers Depot, providing an exceptional customer experience is at the heart of what we do. We're looking for a **Customer Service Manager** who is passionate about building strong customer relationships, developing people and finding better ways to work.

  

In this role, you'll lead and support our Customer Service team, ensuring our customers receive timely, knowledgeable and reliable service. You'll play an important role in shaping the department's processes, setting performance expectations and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen customer relationships and support business growth.

  

This is a hands-on leadership role. We're looking for someone who is comfortable leading from the front, coaching their team while also stepping into day-to-day customer service activities when needed. You'll take the time to understand our customers, systems and processes firsthand so you can effectively support the team and lead continuous improvement.

**Working with us:**

This is a permanent, full-time position based out of the Farmers Depot Head Office at 455 Dobbie Drive in Cambridge, Ontario.

Our Customer Service team serves customers Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:30pm. Your regular working hours will be Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break.

  

As the Customer Service Manager, you'll be responsible for ensuring the department is appropriately staffed and equipped to serve customers throughout core business hours. Occasional work outside standard hours, including weekends, may be required to meet business needs.

  

**What you’ll do:**

  

**Customer Service Leadership**

  

* Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching and support to the Farmers Depot Customer Service team.
* Establish clear departmental objectives, performance expectations and accountability.
* Assess team structure, responsibilities, workflows and operational challenges to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Build employee capabilities through coaching, training, ongoing feedback and development.
* Address performance concerns and support individual and team development.
* Establish consistent communication practices and team routines that encourage collaboration and accountability.
* Lead the implementation of new and revised processes, ensuring employees are trained and accountable for following established procedures.
* Take a hands-on, player-coach approach by actively supporting day-to-day Customer Service activities, including processing customer orders, responding to inquiries, resolving customer concerns and providing coverage during busy periods.
* Develop a strong understanding of departmental systems, processes and workflows to effectively support the team and identify opportunities to improve operations.

  

**Customer Experience & Performance**

  

* Champion an exceptional customer experience by ensuring customer inquiries and concerns are handled promptly and effectively.
* Identify recurring customer issues and implement corrective actions to prevent them from happening again.
* Establish and support consistent processes for managing escalated customer concerns.
* Work collaboratively with other departments to improve communication, coordination and the overall customer experience.
* Use operational data, KPIs and customer feedback to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and service levels.
* Establish and monitor the administration of phone-based marketing and sales campaigns.
* Support cross-departmental managers and product teams in representing products and providing support to producers.

  

**Team Development & Continuous Improvement**

  

* Assess the current capabilities, responsibilities and development needs of the Customer Service team.
* Establish clear role expectations and responsibilities across the department.
* Identify training requirements and implement appropriate development plans.
* Develop processes, procedures and documentation that support consistent and effective departmental operations.

Title: Regional Contract Key Account Manager DXB Customer Service Manager DXB

Description:
**ABOUT BEZOS ACADEMY**

At Bezos Academy, we believe all children deserve the great start that excellent early education provides, including in under-resourced communities. Our mission is to nurture the potential in every child to become a creative leader, original thinker, and lifelong learner by inventing the solutions needed to scale early childhood education. We are a unique organization that realizes our mission in two ways. First, we operate a multi-state network of schools in under-resourced communities, offering quality Montessori-inspired preschool at no cost to families. Second, we create tools, products, technology, and other solutions designed to reach young children and their caregivers well beyond the walls of our schools. We aspire to have a profound, large-scale impact on children ages zero to five.

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As the Senior Food Programs Manager at Bezos Academy, you will own the design, execution, and ongoing improvement of our multi-state preschool network's food programs spanning onsite food preparation, vendor-provided service, and funding through the federal Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP). In this role, you will ensure all students are nourished through a compliant, scalable, and financially optimized program that generates meaningful reimbursement revenue across the network whether the preschool is using vendor-supplied meals and snacks or cooking food from scratch on site. You will set up the metrics by which meal quality, food safety, and cost are measured and help develop training so school staff deliver strong results. You will lead improvements, from vendor procurement to new site launches, that keep food service standardized, compliant, and cost-effective as the network matures. You bring to this role the judgment to balance nutrition, compliance, and cost without compromising on any of them, and the operational rigor to ensure that every child in a Bezos Academy classroom eats nutritional high-quality food across states and sites.

**LOCATION**

* Arizona, Florida, Kentucky, Texas, or Washington and within two hours' drive to multiple Bezos Academy preschools (please see our website for school locations); Seattle, WA preferred.
* Relocation support is available for those willing to relocate to Seattle, WA.

Starting salary will vary by location, qualifications, and prior experience; during the interview process, candidates will learn the starting salary range applicable for their location.

Benefits for this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, a 401(k) plan with a 4% employer contribution match, paid parental leave, an employer-matched flexible spending account for dependent care, and more. Please see here for details.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Eight or more years of relevant experience, including five or more years of experience in project or program management
* Expertise in food programs for schools or other child-centered settings, including knowledge of early childhood nutritional requirements and regulations (USDA Child & Adult Care Food Program, National School Lunch Program, etc.)
* Track record of delivering results through end-to-end program management (e.g., building, executing, monitoring, and continuously improving programs and initiatives)

* Valid state driver's license, clean motor vehicle records, personal auto insurance (at least minimum coverage under applicable law), and access to a reliable vehicle
* Ability to travel to schools or attend team meetings up to 40% of the time depending on business needs

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with managing food program operations across multiple states, relevant solution development and implementation, and end-to-end product delivery
* Experience evaluating operational feasibility and implementation impact, including assessing burden, workflow implications, and trade-offs
* Proven ability to translate complex requirements into clear, concise, and usable expectations

Title: Food & Beverage Director
Description:
**Purpose:**  
The Food Beverage Director has overall responsibility for the daily operations of the culinary services department. This position is responsible for performing all duties in a professional manner at all times and in compliance with established Community policies procedures. The Food Beverage Director ensures that Residents are provided a high-quality culinary experience and that the kitchen services areas are adequately staffed and that the highest quality standards are met. The Food Beverage Director prepares and services meals in a safe and appetizing manner that is in compliance with dietary standards and Community food-related policies procedures. The Food Beverage Director may also be called upon to create, price, and execute menus for Community and private Resident events.

* Manages departmental staffing and labor costs, including overtime.
* Recruits, orientates, trains and evaluates all culinary services staff.
* Assures dining room services provider is performing contract-specific responsibilities.
* Responsible for overseeing culinary services calendar with regard to holidays and requested special events.

**Qualifications:**  

* Degree in Culinary Arts preferred.
* 3 to 5 years’ previous experience in food production/management.
* Must have a Serve Safe certification or become certified within 90 days of hire date.
* Must have basic knowledge of food preparation procedures, proper dining room service etiquette, as well as related Health Department regulations and guidelines pertaining to food service operations.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook), as well as familiarity with the Internet and its search tools.
* Strong organizational, oral, and written communication skills.
* Self-­motivated and ability to work with minimal supervision.
* Results oriented.
* Customer service orientation.
* A proven team player.
* Physically able to bend and reach.
* Physically able to push and pull and lift up to 40-50 pounds as needed.
* Physically able to stand for extended periods of time.
* Ability to work in a hot/humid environment for extended periods of time.
* Can determine food quality and palatability through taste and smell.

Title: Operations Manager (Food Operations)
Description:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
The Operations Manager (Food Operations) owns end-to-end food delivery service quality across the platform, specifically driving ETA promise accuracy, minimizing lateness, and reducing order cancellations. Since most operational levers sit within partner teams (Logistics, Product, Commerce, and Supply), this role operates through rigorous data-driven diagnosis, cross-functional prioritization, and strategic influence rather than direct operational control. Leading a direct team of 6 compliance specialists, the Operations Manager translates high-level service quality targets into actionable initiative portfolios, robust supply-hour requirements, and sustainable marketplace growth.
  
  
**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
**Service Quality & KPI Ownership**

* Own the daily monitoring, weekly review, and detailed root-cause analysis of food delivery metrics across key drivers (prep time, handover timer, distance, zone dynamics, and supply levels).
* Maintain end-to-end accountability for stream targets, including order volume growth (OPU), Mashallah (perfect) order rate, on-time delivery, cancellation rate, and short-distance speed SLAs.
* Act as the primary escalation point for all cross-functional lateness, cancellation, and delivery quality issues.

**Initiative Portfolio & Pilot Management**

* Manage and execute the strategic initiative portfolio: adjust ETA promises, eliminate merchant/zone inefficiencies, speed up merchant dispatch, and tune courier product features.
* Size initiative impacts, assign functional owners, define explicit deadlines, and evaluate pilot results before granting go/no-go approval for full production rollout.
* Collaborate with the Vertical Profitability Manager to establish and enforce strict quality guardrails (TDT, contact rate, lateness, cancellations) for profitability initiatives such as order bundling.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment**

* Logistics & Product Alignment: Work with Logistics Algorithms and Product teams to adjust ETA/DPT accuracy, conduct elasticity tests, manage promotion-day promise adjustments, and enhance courier tools.
* Commerce & Merchant Quality: Partner with Commerce to reduce vendor prep and handover delays, adjust dispatch fitting for complex locations, and enforce merchant quality standards.
* Supply & Fleet Management: Translate service quality targets into precise supply-hour requirements for the Supply Team to drive full-timer (FT) courier acquisition and fleet capacity.

**Team Leadership & Direct Management**

* Directly manage, coach, and guide a direct team of 6 Compliance specialists based in Pakistan.
* Set clear individual performance targets, oversee daily audit workflows, and ensure team alignment with overarching platform quality goals.

**First 90 Days Roadmap & Execution**

* Day 30 (Diagnostics): Complete diagnostic mapping of lateness and cancellation drivers; build comprehensive KPI baselines and size/prioritize the initiative portfolio.
* Day 60 (Pilots): Launch 2–3 live pilots across Logistics, Product, and Commerce; establish weekly cross-functional governance cadences and finalize quality guardrails.
* Day 90 (Production Rollout): Evaluate pilots via go/no-go decisions, transition successful initiatives into production with defined owners and deadlines, and lock in long-term stream targets.

**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years (or 3+ years for strong Middle candidate) in operations, logistics, or marketplace management within on-demand delivery, quick commerce, ride-hailing, or top-tier management consulting.
* Track Record: Proven record of measurably driving core operational metrics (on-time performance, cancellation reduction, ETA promise accuracy).
* Analytical Expertise: Strong capability in data analysis, dashboard building, root-cause investigation, and A/B test design/interpretation. Proficiency in SQL, Python, or Tableau/BI tools is highly advantageous.
* Stakeholder Influence: Exceptional cross-functional project coordination and communication skills; ability to deliver outcomes without direct hierarchical authority.
* Language & Location: Fluent English required. Readiness to relocate to Doha, Qatar. GCC market experience and Arabic language proficiency are strong advantages.

**✨ Bonus Points If You Have**
**Strategic Scope & Work Environment Requirements**

* Cross-Functional Influence & Leadership: Proven ability to drive outcomes across Logistics, Product, Commerce, and Supply teams without direct organizational authority.
* Data-Driven Problem Solving: Continuous monitoring, order-level analytics, and root-cause analysis to pinpoint inefficiencies across prep times, handover delays, zone quality, and dispatch algorithms.
* High-Tempo Execution: Agility to rapidly size initiative impacts, run cross-functional pilots, establish quality guardrails, and implement go/no-go decisions in a fast-growing marketplace environment.

Title: Hotel Manager - Hilton Salwa Beach Resort & Villas
Description:
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

A Hilton Hotel Manager is a hospitality leader, a brand ambassador, and a steward of Hilton’s legacy of delivering exceptional guest experiences. At the heart of every Hilton hotel is a commitment to warm, reliable, and hospitable service—and the Hotel Manager brings this to life through thoughtful leadership and operational excellence.

**About the Hilton Brand**

For nearly a century, Hilton Hotels & Resorts has been proudly welcoming the world’s travellers. With more than 584 hotels across six continents, Hilton Hotels & Resorts provides the foundation for exceptional travel experiences and values every guest who walks through its doors. The most recognised name in the industry, Hilton remains synonymous with the word ‘hotel’. From inaugural balls and Hollywood award galas to business events and days to remember, Hilton is where the world makes history, closes the deal, toasts special occasions, and gets away from it all. As the flagship brand of Hilton, Hilton Hotels & Resorts continues to set the standard for hospitality, providing new product innovations and services to meet guests’ evolving needs.

One of the largest resorts in the Middle East, Hilton Salwa Beach Resort & Villas is an unparalleled destination offering world-class facilities and bespoke services for today’s luxury leisure travellers. Sprawling across 3.5 kms of prime coastline, the resort offers 361 rooms, including 84 beachfront villas, the largest water park in Qatar- Desert Falls Water and Adventure Park, more than 20 restaurants showcasing global flavours, a beach club, swimming pools, a marina, luxury spa and a health club.

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

As a **Hotel Manager** at a Hilton property, you’re not just leading hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Your responsibilities will include:

* **Lead with Hilton’s commitment to exceptional hospitality:** Oversee all hotel operations to deliver warm, reliable, and hospitable service – ensuring every guest experience is seamless, consistent, and reflective of the brand’s high standards
* **Drive performance and profitability:** Manage revenue, budgets, and cost controls to achieve financial targets while balancing operational efficiency with innovative guest experiences
* **Oversee property priorities:** Lead capital projects, refurbishments, and service initiatives to maintain operational excellence and brand alignment
* **Set and execute strategic direction:** Shape short- and long-term goals, making decisions in the best interests of the hotel, the Hilton brand, and Hilton’s long-term vision
* **Inspire and develop talent:** Provide visionary leadership to the executive team and all Team Members, embedding Hilton’s values and fostering a team of passionate and creative professionals

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on leader, with a strong focus on owner relations, commercial performance, and operational excellence. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

* Having strong international brand experience in a luxury resort environment is preferred.
* Extensive multi-cultural experience, adept at working with diverse teams and customers.
* Strong ability to collaborate and foster networks and relationships, with owners, contractors, corporates, and Tour Operators – must be highly visible.
* Demonstrable experience in delivering innovative commercial opportunities with experience in increasing profitability especially within Resorts.
* Dynamic and proactive approach with solid experience as an agent of change
* Exceptional people leadership and retention of talent with the ability to bring a team together on a journey and instilling the Hilton culture and values.
* Exceptional stakeholder/owner relations experience with demonstrable influencing skills.
* Ability to show resilience, judgement and leadership.
* Experience managing budgets, revenue proposals, and forecasting results in a similar resort style property.
* Proven experience in delivering results with an eye for details and quality
* Experience in GCC/Qatar will be an advantage
* Degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent.
* Fluency in English and Arabic required (spoken and written)

  

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Title: The Berkeley Hotel Executive Housekeeper

Looking for an inspired leader to head up our housekeeping department at the historic luxury Berkeley Hotel.

55 rooms. Previous hotel management housekeeping required. Must be able to work weekends. As this is a smaller hotel, the exec would be expected to have a board of their own near daily.

**Our Vision**

Our vision is to become the premier hotel development company with a concentration in Washington, committed to excellence through strategic development and continued innovation in the hospitality industry. The Hotel Executive Housekeeper at Berkeley plays a pivotal role in ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness and guest satisfaction throughout the property. This leadership position is responsible for managing and supervising the housekeeping team to maintain impeccable guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces. The Executive Housekeeper will develop and implement cleaning procedures, schedules, and quality control measures to optimize operational efficiency and uphold brand standards. Additionally, this role involves coordinating with other hotel departments to support seamless guest experiences and address any housekeeping-related concerns promptly. Ultimately, the Executive Housekeeper contributes significantly to the hotel's reputation by fostering a clean, safe, and welcoming environment for all guests and staff.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 1 years of experience in housekeeping, with at least 1 year in a supervisory or management role.
* Strong knowledge of cleaning.
* Ability to lead and motivate a diverse team effectively.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working in a branded hotel environment.
* Familiarity with budgeting and inventory management.
* Knowledge of OSHA regulations and environmental sustainability practices.
* Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish, to communicate with a diverse workforce.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead, train, and supervise the housekeeping team to ensure consistent delivery of high-quality cleaning services.
* Develop and maintain cleaning schedules, inventory controls, and quality assurance protocols to meet brand and safety standards.
* Inspect guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces regularly to ensure cleanliness and maintenance needs are addressed.
* Collaborate with the front desk, maintenance, and management teams to coordinate room availability and resolve guest requests or complaints.
* Manage housekeeping budgets, including labor costs, supplies, and equipment procurement, while optimizing resource utilization.
* Recruit, onboard, and evaluate housekeeping staff performance, fostering a positive and productive work environment.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations.

**Skills:**

The Executive Housekeeper utilizes leadership and interpersonal skills daily to manage and inspire the housekeeping team, ensuring high morale and productivity. Organizational skills are critical for creating efficient cleaning schedules, managing inventory, and maintaining compliance with safety standards. Title: Marketing Operations Manager
Description:
Deep Knowledge Group · MarTech Department · Reports to the Head of MarTech

**The role**
------------

Deep Knowledge Group runs a portfolio of longevity and health-tech websites and platforms. Today the website tracking, the application analytics, the CRM and the campaign reports each work on their own. You will connect them: set up tracking, run the analytics and CRM systems, and make sure enquiries and reports reach the people who act on them.

**What you will own**
---------------------

### **Tracking and measurement**

* Create and run the company’s Google tag / GA4 account, install tags across Wix, custom-HTML and application sites, and remove the legacy tags that would double-fire.
* Verify sites in Search Console, submit sitemaps and keep reporting access working.
* Implement advertising pixels and conversion events with consent handling.
* Test that events actually arrive, with source, consent and duplicate checks, and keep a coverage record per site.

### **Analytics platform (PostHog)**

* Define a small shared event set, source and campaign fields, and how an anonymous visitor becomes a known contact.
* Run PostHog: projects, access, cost, identity handoff between domains, and event-based dashboards that update without manual spreadsheets.

### **CRM and automation (HubSpot)**

* Map form submissions, sources and outcomes into CRM contacts, with duplicate handling.
* Repair and maintain inbound email classification and routing, so every actionable enquiry reaches a named owner.
* Build audience segments with clear entry, exit and suppression rules, and run one follow-up workflow with the BisDev team.

### **Reporting and process**

* Keep dashboards labelled with data freshness and alert on collection failures.
* Document the setup so another person can run it: procedures, event definitions and a record of every automation and its owner.

**Your first 90 days**
----------------------

* Weeks 1–4: take over the new Google tag account, verify the priority sites in Search Console, and record a baseline of what tracks and what doesn’t.
* Weeks 5–8: agree the event and identity rules, and install tracking on the pilot sites in a way that survives page changes.
* Weeks 9–13: connect forms to the CRM, fix enquiry routing, and publish the first automatically updated dashboard.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years in marketing operations, marketing analytics or a similar hands-on role.
* Hands-on with Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Search Console, including consent and debugging.
* Experience with a CRM and marketing automation, ideally HubSpot (we also have Zoho in use), including forms, workflows and routing.
* Experience with an event analytics tool such as PostHog, Mixpanel or Amplitude, including user identity.
* Comfortable reading page source and network requests to confirm that tracking works.
* You write clearly and document what you build.

### **Helpful**

* Experience with Wix and custom or application sites, and Cloudflare.
* Server-side tracking or conversion APIs.
* Basic SQL or scripting.
* Experience with GDPR or similar consent rules.
* Fluent Russian.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* Web development: page templates, the scheduled checking worker and site fixes belong to a web engineer.
* Content and SEO writing, which belongs to the editor.
* Commercial follow-up, which BisDev owns. You build the routing and fields; they run the conversations.

**How you will work**
---------------------

You will work with the Head of MarTech, the web operations specialist (forms, publishing and web edits), the BisDev team, Front-end and Product. Tools include Google Tag Manager, GA4, Search Console, PostHog, HubSpot, Slack and Google Workspace. Working hours are flexible, with overlap with UK time (our team works roughly 8:00–18:00 UK).

Title: Head of Sales
Description:
**About Us**

Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence. We partner with national, regional, and local insurance carriers and Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the U.S. to solve their most critical challenges. Our expertise spans Product Development, Actuarial Services, Regulatory Compliance, State Filings, and Data Analytics. Our mission is simple: build lasting partnerships and deliver technology-driven outcomes that fuel business success.

We recently acquired Adaptify, bringing its engineering team in-house and accelerating our platform roadmap. We are now a fully remote team backed by private equity, with consulting expertise and technology under one roof.

**The Opportunity**

We are hiring a Head of Sales to lead our sales team day to day and build the sales engine for Martin’s next stage of growth. In this newly created role, you will own team performance, pipeline, forecasting, and sales process. That frees our Chief Revenue Officer to focus on revenue strategy, strategic relationships and new markets.

With our recent acquisition of Adaptify, we have a bigger story to tell and a broader offering to sell. This role will shape how we take that combined offering to market.

Selling at Martin is consultative. Our clients increasingly buy expertise and software together, and our deals range from productized platform sales to complex, custom engagements. You will lead a team that sells both well, working alongside Sales Engineers and our Professional Services Group so that what we sell is what we deliver.

This is a builder's role. We are looking for a leader who coaches as well as they close, who brings structure without slowing the team down, and who is energized by taking a capable sales team to the next level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead and develop the sales team**

* Manage, coach and develop the sales team through regular one-on-ones, deal coaching and call reviews
* Set clear expectations for activity, pipeline and results, and hold the team accountable to them
* Hire, onboard and ramp new sellers as the team grows
* Build the team's fluency in selling services and software together

**Own pipeline, forecast and results**

* Own team quota attainment across new business and expansion
* Run a disciplined pipeline and forecast cadence, and report results to the CRO and executive team
* Stay close to the deals that matter: join key client conversations, shape strategy and help the team close
* Use CRM data to spot what is working, what is stalling and where to focus

**Build the sales engine**

* Define and document a repeatable sales process, from qualification through close, for both productized and custom deals
* Establish the playbooks, messaging and tools the team needs to sell consistently
* Partner with the CRO on territory and account planning, pricing approach and compensation design
* Work with Marketing on pipeline generation and with Product on market feedback
* Lead the team's shift to selling the combined services and technology offering, including positioning, messaging and cross-sell into existing clients

**Partner across the business**

* Work with Sales Engineers on discovery, demonstrations and solution design
* Bring the Professional Services Group into deals early so scope, pricing and timelines are right before signature
* Represent Sales in deal review alongside Operations, Finance and Product
* Stay engaged through the transition from sale to delivery, so clients experience one team
* Coordinate with Account Management on renewals and growth within existing clients

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of B2B sales experience, including 3+ years leading and developing a sales team
* A record of meeting or beating team targets in a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale
* Experience selling professional services, software, or ideally both together
* Insurance, insurtech or financial services experience strongly preferred; curiosity and the ability to learn a technical domain quickly are required
* Experience building sales process and forecasting discipline in a growth-stage company, ideally PE- or VC-backed
* A coaching mindset, with examples of sellers you have developed and promoted
* Comfort working in the details: CRM data, deal strategy and live client conversations
* The ability to build trust across Sales, Delivery, Product and Finance in a fully remote company

**Why Join Us?**

* **Real scope at the right moment.** You will shape how Martin sells as we scale, with direct access to the CRO and executive team.
* **Expertise that scales.** Our value comes from deep insurance expertise, delivered through people and a platform. You will sell something clients need and that few firms can offer.
* **Own the outcomes.** We give leaders room to build and expect them to deliver. You will have the mandate to make the changes the team needs.
* **Do the right thing.** We sell what we can deliver and stand behind it. Long-term client trust matters more to us than a quick close.

* **A remote team that stays connected.** We are fully remote by design and invest in bringing people together.
* **Momentum you can sell.** A recent acquisition, an expanded engineering team and private equity backing give us the product, the resources and the ambition to grow.

**Salary and Benefits**

* **Base salary:** $185,000 – $210,000, based on experience.

* **Variable compensation:** On-target earnings (OTE) of $290,000 – $330,000, with an approximately 65/35 base-to-variable mix. Variable pay is tied to team performance.
* **Benefits:** Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance, including:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan options
* Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy
* Fully remote work environment

The Head of Supply Chain will provide strategic and operational leadership for all U.S.-based supply chain activities, including demand planning, supply planning, procurement, inventory management, customer supply chain collaboration, logistics, and S&OP.

Reporting to the Associate Vice President of Supply Chain and this individual will be responsible for creating a high-performing, data-driven supply chain organization that supports Sirio's commitment to quality, compliance, service, and continuous improvement.
