**Inventory & Planning Excellence**

* Optimize inventory levels to improve working capital while maintaining service levels.
* Improve inventory accuracy, material availability, and planning discipline.
* Drive development of inventory policies, safety stock strategies, and replenishment methodologies.

**Logistics & Customer Supply Chain**

* Oversee inbound and outbound logistics strategies supporting domestic and international operations.
* Strengthen customer collaboration processes to improve forecast visibility and service performance.
* Ensure achievement of customer delivery commitments and OTIF objectives.

**Continuous Improvement & Transformation**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies throughout the supply chain organization.
* Use data and KPIs to identify opportunities for efficiency gains, waste reduction, and service improvements.
* Lead supply chain process digitization, automation, and systems improvements.
* Establish a culture where teams proactively solve problems, eliminate inefficiencies, and continuously raise performance standards.

**Compliance & Quality Partnership**

* Partner closely with Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and Operations to support FDA, GMP, and customer compliance requirements.
* Ensure robust material traceability, supplier qualification, and change management processes.
* Support customer audits and regulatory inspections as a supply chain subject matter expert.

**Global Supply Chain Collaboration & Network Integration**

* Serve as the primary U.S. supply chain leader and strategic partner to Sirio's Global Supply Chain organization, ensuring alignment between regional execution and global business objectives.
* Collaborate closely with Global teams to balance customer demand, manufacturing capacity, inventory strategies, and material availability across the global network.
* Drive alignment of production plans and inventory positioning between U.S. operations and international manufacturing sites to support customer service, working capital, and growth objectives.
* Partner with Global Logistics leadership to optimize international transportation, warehousing, import/export activities, and distribution strategies.
* Identify and mitigate supply risks related to global sourcing, extended lead times, transportation constraints, geopolitical events, and regulatory requirements.

* 10+ years of progressive supply chain leadership experience.

Title: Storekeeper cum Buyer
Description:
**Job Summary**

The Store Keeper cum Buyer is responsible for managing the hotel's inventory, receiving, storing, issuing, and purchasing of goods and materials required for daily hotel operations. The position ensures that all items are procured at competitive prices, maintained at appropriate stock levels, and delivered in accordance with the hotel's quality standards and operational requirements.

The role involves coordinating with various departments, suppliers, and the Finance Department to ensure efficient stock control, timely procurement, cost management, and compliance with hotel purchasing procedures.

**Key Responsibilities1. Store & Inventory Management**

* Receive, inspect, and verify all incoming goods against purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices.
* Ensure all received items meet the hotel's quality and quantity requirements.
* Maintain proper storage, handling, and organization of goods in designated storage areas.
* Monitor stock levels and ensure adequate inventory is maintained.
* Issue goods to various hotel departments against approved requisitions.
* Conduct regular stock counts and participate in monthly inventory checks.
* Maintain accurate records of stock receipts, issues, transfers, and balances.
* Monitor expiry dates and ensure proper stock rotation using FIFO (First In, First Out).
* Report damaged, expired, or slow-moving items to the concerned department.

**2. Purchasing & Procurement**

* Source products and materials based on approved purchase requests from hotel departments.
* Obtain quotations from suppliers and compare prices, quality, and delivery terms.
* Prepare purchase orders in accordance with the hotel's procurement procedures.
* Follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of ordered goods.
* Negotiate with suppliers to obtain competitive prices and favorable payment terms.
* Maintain good professional relationships with suppliers and service providers.
* Ensure purchased items comply with the hotel's quality standards and specifications.
* Identify alternative suppliers and cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.
* Coordinate with the Finance Department regarding invoices, quotations, and payment documentation.

**3. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, quotations, delivery notes, and invoices.
* Ensure all purchasing and inventory transactions are properly documented.
* Prepare monthly stock reports and inventory summaries.
* Monitor stock consumption and report unusual variations.
* Ensure proper filing and documentation for internal and external audits.
* Follow hotel purchasing policies, financial procedures, and internal control standards.

**4. Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate with all hotel departments to understand their purchasing and stock requirements.
* Communicate with suppliers regarding product availability, pricing, and delivery schedules.
* Work closely with the Finance, Cost Control, and operational teams.
* Respond promptly to urgent departmental requirements while following approval procedures.
* Maintain effective communication with the Director of Finance and Purchasing Manager.

**5. Health, Safety & Compliance**

* Maintain cleanliness, hygiene, and safety standards within all storage areas.
* Ensure proper storage of food, chemicals, equipment, and other materials.
* Follow hotel health and safety policies and applicable UAE regulations.
* Ensure restricted and hazardous materials are stored and handled appropriately.
* Maintain confidentiality of supplier pricing, contracts, and purchasing information.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Purchasing, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in storekeeping and purchasing, preferably within the hospitality industry.
* Previous experience in hotel stores, procurement, and inventory management is an advantage.
* Knowledge of inventory control, purchasing procedures, and supplier management.
* Familiarity with hotel operating systems and inventory software.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Good negotiation and supplier management skills.
* Strong organizational and inventory control abilities.
* Good numerical and analytical skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and email correspondence.
* Knowledge of FIFO and stock management procedures.
* Honest, reliable, and committed to maintaining company standards.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Accuracy of stock records and inventory reports.
* Timely procurement and delivery of requested items.
* Effective inventory control and reduction of unnecessary stock.
* Cost savings through competitive supplier negotiations.
* Compliance with purchasing and inventory procedures.
* Minimization of stock shortages, wastage, and expired items.

**General Responsibilities**

* Perform any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or Management.
* Demonstrate the Accor values and uphold the Heartist culture.
* Maintain professional conduct and support teamwork across all hotel departments.
* Contribute to delivering operational excellence and guest satisfaction.

**Department:** Finance / Stores & Purchasing

**Position:** Store Keeper cum Buyer

**Location:** Mercure Hotel Suites & Apartments, Barsha Heights, Dubai, UAE

**Reports To:** Assistant Purchasing Manage/Purchasing Manager

Pay: AED2,250.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Health Coordinator
Description:
Are you a socially conscious, dedicated individual who is committed to building a better future for children, families, and their communities? If so, join us as we support early childhood education programs across the country to create positive outcomes for the children and families served.

The **Health Coordinator** is responsible for a team of Health Advocates working to ensure that all children in their assigned centers are up to date on EPSDT requirements, receive health follow-ups on acute and chronic conditions, and have medical and dental homes.

**Why Acelero?**

Our mission is bold: To design and deliver research and evidence-based approaches to eliminate the gaps between young childrenʼs inherent potential and their achievement in school and life. With our partners, we accelerate child and family outcomes that honor all of the aspirations and cultures of the communities we serve.

Our values: Data-Informed Learning; Transparent & Open Communication; Growth Mindset; Championing Equality; Caring Teams & Communities.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Provides coaching and support to family services and health staff to assure the reliability of family assessment and goal progress data, and to strengthen staff focus on outcomes-focused family interventions.
* Oversees Health and Disabilities Advocates to assure that all children in the program are up to date on Early Periodic Screening Diagnostic and Treatment (EPSDT) preventative health care requirements and receive timely follow up evaluation and treatment.
* Oversees Health and Disabilities Advocates to assure that all families have quality medical and dental homes, and maintain consistent health insurance coverage, if eligible.
* Provides guidance and support to Health and Disabilities Advocates to complete Individual Care Plans for children with chronic health conditions and follows up to ensure that children’s health conditions are effectively managed.

* Utilizes qualitative audit and external evaluation data to track child and family outcomes and to refine strategies to enhance family impact.

* Develops and aligns program wide health and wellness campaigns with agency mission; including promoting consistent family routines that support healthy lifestyles and habits.

* Supervises assigned department personnel. Includes the following responsibilities, but are not limited to: hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, and ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and the completion of all work performed by direct reports.
* Educates direct reports on all department and company policies and procedures.
* Meets with assigned staff regularly to identify and resolve problems, manage projects, track goals, and review work processes and procedures.

2. At least 3 years of experience working with diverse families in low-income communities on health and wellness interventions, including evidence-based strategies to reduce health disparities, with supervisory responsibilities.

3. Background and understanding of child preventative health, including EPSDT requirements for children 0-5 years old.

4. CPR and First Aid Certifications or ability to obtain within 1 year of employment.

5. Physical exam and background checks are required for this position.

6. Travel required locally or long-distance up to 10% of the time for work-related meetings and functions.

* A collaborative, inclusive team that values your growth and well-being

  + Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care expenses

Title: Sr Mgr, Solutions Architecture, MENAT AGS SA
Description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and committed support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

In collaboration with sales, you should help drive revenue growth across a broad set of customers across industries. As a trusted customer advocate, you should help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions. You should seek out opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broaden the use of the AWS platform across the customer's organization. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Sr. Manager, Solutions Architect you are joining a team that invests in your success by providing a comprehensive learning program. The AWS Solutions Architecture team provides an opportunity to work in an open environment that includes self-paced learning, instructor-led training, hands-on projects, and job shadowing opportunities to develop your knowledge of the AWS ecosystem of services and solutions. The ideal candidate has a curious mind, a thirst for knowledge, and a desire to understand how technology works. By working backwards from defined customer outcomes, you achieve results that delight AWS customers. You enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and develop new ones so you can make meaningful contributions to long-term customer success.

Serve as a leader for the SA team, and a key member of the business development team.
  
  
Hire, enable, and develop an industry-leading team of solutions architects
  
  
Build deep relationships with customers to become a trusted advisor for their most critical workloads that support their digital transformation and journey to the cloud.

Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud.
  
  
Contribute to AWS internal and customer-facing publications such as white-papers and blogs as a means of scaling your knowledge.
  
  
Act as a liaison between customers, service engineering teams, and support to address customer needs.

No two days look the same. You might start the morning reviewing a customer architecture with one of your SAs, then join a pipeline review with your Sales counterpart mid-morning. * 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.

As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of AWS owned data centres, Hybrid Colo's, Single Tennent Colo and Multi Tennent Colo builds . The AWS Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You will be responsible for supporting vendors, contractors and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:  
  

* Medium and low voltage power systems
* Generators
* UPS
* HVAC
* Chilled Water Systems
* Building Management systems (BMS)
* Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)

The CxE's daily focus is to ensure the commissioning quality and progress meet AWS's high standards by:  
Developing commissioning standards.  
Reviewing, comment on, and creating commissioning scripts L1-L5.  
Organize and attend meetings highlighting AWS requirements and tracking overall build and commissioning progress and blockers.  
Performing site walks to identify installation and testing deficiencies and maintain observation logs.  
Manage on-site 3rd-party commissioning vendors to ensure coverage of all Cx-activities.

Work with AWS partner teams to resolve coordination and delivery issues and report on project health and completion.

The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCCD organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. * 4+ years of commissioning experience
* Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities

**Summary:**

The Production Superintendent organizes and schedules the activities of the employees working on the production crews to produce cost-effective amounts of clinker and cement, according to quality control specifications and plant production goals. This position coordinates production activities with other departments to ensure shipping, maintenance, and quarry activities are in sync with production schedules. The position supervises a medium team of employees.

**What you’ll be contributing:**

* Promote and follow all plant safety guidelines.
* Prioritizes, assigns, and communicates tasks for the employees working on the teams.

* Assists with Investigations and reporting accidents and incidents as required by internal contacts and external agencies.

* Ability to lead/manage others

* Ability to make decisions and to exercise sound judgment in arriving at a conclusion
* Knowledge of kiln and mill operations, mobile equipment, machinery functions, and production process control

* Ability to understand and comply with safety and environmental regulations
* Ability to work under general supervision with specified objectives, policies, and performance standards
* Ability to refer to supervisor when in doubt as to the proper procedure for a specified action

Title: Lease Administrator
Description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Dentalcorp is seeking a **Lease Administrator** to support the day-to-day administration of our growing lease portfolio of more than 650 locations. Reporting to the Director, Lease Administration and Audit Services, you will help ensure lease information, rent payments, reconciliations, and landlord correspondence are managed accurately and in accordance with lease terms.

Based at our Support Centre in Toronto, Ontario, this permanent, full-time opportunity is ideal for someone who brings strong lease administration expertise and wants to contribute within a collaborative, fast-growing organization. You will work closely with internal partners across Construction and Maintenance, Operations, Legal, and Finance while building effective relationships with practices and landlords.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You are a service-oriented and highly detail-oriented professional with experience in lease administration, property accounting, or property management.
* You are comfortable interpreting complex commercial lease documents, analyzing financial information, and identifying discrepancies.
* You thrive in a collaborative environment but are equally comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and taking ownership of your responsibilities.
* You communicate clearly, approach landlord and tenant matters thoughtfully, and are committed to providing excellent service to our Partners and their teams.

**In This Role, You Will**
--------------------------

* Analyze annual landlord reconciliation statements to confirm accuracy and compliance with lease terms.
* Review annual rent adjustment notices, escalations, and real estate tax invoices provided by landlords.
* Enter, validate, and maintain lease documents, invoices, and related information in Visual Lease.
* Conduct rent variance analyses and process rent and invoice payments.
* Prepare monthly reports and payment uploads to support accurate and timely rent payments to landlords.
* Interpret commercial lease documents, including leases, amendments, assignments, and subleases.
* Investigate and resolve landlord and tenant issues related to rent, invoicing, and lease compliance.
* Manage relationships with practices and landlords, including landlord correspondence and negotiation.
* Collaborate with Construction and Maintenance, Operations, Legal, and Finance to address lease-related matters.
* Perform other related duties as required.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* A university or college degree in a related discipline, preferably Real Estate, Commerce, Business, or Accounting.
* At least three years of experience in lease administration, property accounting, or property management.
* Demonstrated experience reviewing and interpreting complex commercial lease documents.
* Experience working in a commercial leasing environment with a large national landlord or tenant is considered an asset.
* Experience using a real estate database, preferably Visual Lease.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to review reconciliations, rent adjustments, tax invoices, and payment variances.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong time-management and administrative skills, with a high level of attention to detail.
* The ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and collaborate effectively across departments.

**Why Dentalcorp?**
-------------------

Dentalcorp is North America’s leading and fastest-growing network of dental practices. Through industry-leading technology, expertise, and scale, we help practices grow while supporting dental professionals to retain their clinical autonomy. Here, you’ll be trusted with meaningful responsibility, supported to grow, and surrounded by people who share ideas and raise the bar together. Our **Beyond Brilliant** values—**Beyond the Status Quo**, **Beyond Excellence**, **Brilliant Together**, and **Brilliant Experiences**—guide how we innovate, collaborate, deliver, and put people at the centre.

The salary range for this position is $65,000 CAD to $80,000 CAD annually (plus a bonus of up to 10% and competitive total rewards and benefits package). Offers within this range are determined based on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as internal equity considerations. This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

You will be based at our **Toronto Support Centre**, located at **181 Bay Street** in the heart of Toronto’s financial district. This position will be on site from Monday to Thursday, with Fridays designated as work-from-home days.

*Candidates must be legally eligible to work in Canada. At Dentalcorp, we recognize that inclusivity and diversity strengthen our culture and make us better. We are committed to ensuring that the talent we hire is reflective of the diverse communities and patients we serve. To ensure equal opportunity for all candidates, we strongly encourage applicants requiring an accommodation to let their recruiter know during the recruitment/selection process. We appreciate all applicants for taking the time to apply, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.*

Title: SRO, Customer Excellence.
Description:
We are looking for a Senior Responsible Owner (SRO) for Customer Excellence to lead Echelon’s Customer Excellence Program and own the customer 360, our single view of each customer. You will set how AI agents and account teams work together, so that everyone who serves a customer works from the same, accurate picture.

**The role: one view of the customer**
--------------------------------------

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you own the customer 360 across our accounts. You work with the CRO’s account teams, the Head of AI Transformation and the deployment strategists, the engineers in the pods, and the leadership team. You bring partner insight into each customer’s view and work closely with the marketing and communications lead on customer engagements.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* **Build the customer 360.** One record and one account plan per customer, kept current by AI agents and approved by the account owner: organization and decision makers, systems and data landscape, AI maturity, contracts, projects, pipeline, delivery history and value delivered.
* **Own customer data.** The quality of customer data in our CRM and delivery tools: what is captured, by whom and when, who can edit it, and how the account teams and pods use it.
* **Read the customer.** Each customer’s strategy, budgets, AI priorities, leadership changes and buying cycles, briefed to the account teams and strategists before key meetings.
* **Measure customer health.** Satisfaction and health measures across accounts, feedback after each engagement, and early warnings on accounts at risk.
* **Run the cadence.** The weekly presence on accounts: account reviews, executive touchpoints, customer events and programs, and their follow-up.
* **Inform leadership.** A regular customer review for the COO and the leadership team: where we win, where we lose, and what customers ask for that we do not yet deliver.

**What you bring**
------------------

* **Customer record:** 6+ years in customer success, account operations, CRM or customer analytics in a technology or services business.
* **Data fluency:** At ease with CRM systems, dashboards and imperfect data, and able to make them useful to others.
* **Rigour:** You keep records accurate and current without being asked, and build simple processes that last.
* **Connector:** You work across sales, delivery and leadership, and earn trust by being useful.
* **AI fluency:** You find use cases for AI and turn them into agentic workflows that serve the Customer Excellence Program end to end, and you decide where a person must review their work.

**Strong advantage**
--------------------

* **Sector knowledge:** Experience with customers in a sector where Echelon leads, such as government, energy, financial services or healthcare.
* **CRM platforms:** Hands-on administration of a major CRM platform.
* **Arabic:** Professional fluency in Arabic.

**Our values**
--------------

* **Customer first:** You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritize accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality:** You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* **Long-term builder:** You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.
* **Builds others:** You measure yourself by the people you develop and the capability you build with customers.

**How we work**
---------------

You start from the customer’s problem and choose the tool to fit it. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.

* **Curiosity:** You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves.
* **Speed:** You move from brief to a first working result quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* **Rigour:** You test claims against the data, check what is delivered and can explain every choice.
* **Confidence and humility:** You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* **Autonomy:** You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organize the work yourself.
* **Resourcefulness:** Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar organization: you find a way with what is available.
* **Situational leadership:** You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* **A force multiplier:** Your playbooks, reviews and coaching make the whole bench faster.
* **AI-native depth:** AI tools are part of how you research, write and decide. You are comfortable working alongside AI agents and setting the rules for when a person must approve their work.
* **Who you are:** An organized operator who loves customers and data in equal measure, and wants to build a function from the start.

------------

* **Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
* **Reports to:** Chief Operating Officer
* **Travel:** Time at customer sites and events across the Kingdom
* **Package:** A base salary with housing, transport and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity program. Terms are shared at offer stage.

Title: Process Coordinator
Description:
Role summary

The Process Coordinator leads AI-led process redesign. The role takes each business process cuts it down to the steps and fields that matter, gets the rules built into Zoho CRM, and replaces manual reports with live, AI-generated dashboards for each department and role.

The goal is simple: people put the right data in the right place at the right time, and AI turns it into decisions. Managers and coordinators should stop building reports and chasing updates by hand.

This is a process and data role, not a training role. The right person reads workflows and Zoho logic, thinks in fields and data, and is comfortable shortening a process and challenging a manager when a step adds no value.

Key responsibilities1. Process redesign

* Map each current process end to end from the CRM field list, the current SOP and how the team actually works.

* Cut steps and fields that do not feed a decision or a report.

* Set one owner and one time limit for every stage.

* Define the blocking rules the CRM must enforce (for example, no case closes without evidence; no paid job closes without an invoice number), each with a logged override.

* Link modules so data flows without re-entry (for example, case to invoice; confirmed deal to PRQ, PO and delivery).

* Write the one-page SOP for each process: stage, owner, time limit, what must exist before moving on, and what is automatic.

* Take each redesign to the department head and the fortnightly Signal review for approval; L&D then signs off the final SOP.

2. Live dashboards with AI tools

* Own the live dashboards produced through AI tools and Zoho Analytics.

* Assign department-specific and role-specific dashboards: what a sales coordinator, a manager, a division manager and a department head each need to see every day.

* Use the dashboards in real-time reviews and daily huddles so discussions run on live data, not on spreadsheets prepared the night before.

* Set up daily exception lists and weekly reports pulled automatically from the CRM and from source documents (SOPs, POs, invoices, PRQs), so nobody types the same data twice.

* Check data quality before trusting a dashboard: blocking rules come before dashboards, because AI on bad data gives confident wrong answers.

3. Less manual work

* Find every manual report, Excel tracker and repeated hand-off in each department and replace it with a dashboard or an automatic summary.

* Formally retire the old report the day the new dashboard goes live, so teams do not run both.

* Work with IT to clean up automatic tasks that a CRM rule can replace, and raise on-time completion of tasks.

* Track and report manual reporting hours removed.

4. Rollout and adoption

* Run the 8-step redesign cycle for each process: AI baseline audit, design, build, pilot, measure, fix, roll out, retire the old way.

* Write clear build requirements for IT (fields, module links, Blueprint rules, automations) and test them before go-live.

* Support DMs and department heads, who own adoption in their teams.

* Prepare and present at the fortnightly Signal review with senior leadership and IT: designs for approval, blockers and numbers against baseline.

Role requirements

* Can read a Zoho CRM module (fields, layouts, Blueprints, workflows) and explain what it does and where it breaks.

* Can take a field list and an SOP and produce a shorter, rule-based process on paper within a day.

* Uses AI tools daily for analysis, summaries and dashboards, and knows how to check their output.

* Comfortable telling a senior manager that a step or a report should go, and backing it with data.

* Measures improvement as numbers against a baseline, not opinions.

* Leads change across departments and holds a redesign under challenge from senior managers, with the Sponsor's backing.

* Fluent written and spoken English; Arabic or Hindi is a plus.

Education

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems, Operations Management, Business Analytics or a related field.

Industry experience

* **4-6 years** in process improvement, business analysis, CRM operations or sales/service operations.

* At least **2 years hands-on with a CRM**, ideally Zoho CRM (Salesforce or Dynamics also acceptable).

* Experience in **B2B trading, industrial equipment, distribution or after-sales service**, preferably in the UAE or GCC.

* Has led at least one process redesign or CRM rollout from mapping to go-live, with measurable results.

* Experience building or running management dashboards that replaced manual reports.

**Required skills**

Technical

* Zoho CRM: modules, fields, layouts, Blueprints, workflow rules, reports

* Dashboards and BI: Zoho Analytics, Power BI or similar

* AI tools for analysis and reporting (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot), including pulling data from documents and CRM exports

* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets (pivots, lookups, data cleaning)

* Process mapping (Visio, Lucidchart, Miro or BPMN tools)

* Basic understanding of automations and integrations (Deluge, APIs, Zapier) is a plus

Analytical

* Reads data and fields to find where a process breaks

* Builds a baseline and measures change against it

* Spots bad data and its root cause before it reaches a dashboard

* Turns findings into a short, clear decision for a manager

Behavioural

* Simplifier: removes steps instead of adding them

* Confident with senior managers; willing to challenge

* Structured and finishes what it starts: one process at a time, closed properly

* Clear writer: one-page SOPs, short build specs, plain reports

* Patient with teams during change; firm on the rules

Pay: AED3,000.00 - AED4,500.00 per month

Title: Field CISO
Description:
**Onwards Together!**
---------------------

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

**Our Team's Vision:**
----------------------

Illumio is the breach containment company. Built on Zero Trust principles, the Illumio platform combines real-time visibility with segmentation and AI-powered detection and response, helping organizations stop the spread of breaches and ransomware across hybrid, multi-cloud, and on-premises environments before they become disasters. Illumio Segmentation contains attackers by stopping lateral movement across the enterprise, and Illumio Insights delivers AI-driven visibility and detection across hybrid cloud environments.

Illumio was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Microsegmentation Solutions, Q3 2026, earning the highest scores in current offering and strategy of any vendor evaluated, and is recognized as a Customers’ Choice in Gartner Peer Insights for Network Security – Microsegmentation. Global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, energy and utilities, government, manufacturing, retail, and telecommunications trust Illumio to reduce cyber risk and build resilience.

**Our Values**
==============

Our values reflect how we work together in practice — not just what we aspire to. They show up in everyday decisions, how we collaborate across teams, and how we treat each other while building and delivering our work. If these values resonate with you, you’ll likely feel at home here.

* **Bring Your Best:** We hold ourselves to a standard of excellence for our customers and each other, regardless of circumstance.
* **Build Trust:** We act with integrity, transparency, and follow-through, earning trust in every interaction.
* **Seek Truth:** We pursue facts over assumptions, stay curious, and remain open to being wrong.
* **Onwards Together:** We move forward as one team, supporting each other through challenges and wins alike.
* **Leverage Differences:** We treat diverse perspectives and backgrounds as a source of strength and better decisions.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Field CISO, Zero Trust Segmentation is a newly created, specialized role within the Global Solutions Engineering team, chartered to deepen Illumio’s credibility and category leadership within the CISO community. This role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community: we are looking for a security executive — a current or former CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security leader — who brings a proven balance of business acumen, technical depth, and operational experience running a security program, rather than a traditional pre-sales background. This is a hybrid role by design: half executive advisor and evangelist, half hands-on architect.

As Field CISO, this person is Illumio’s most credible external voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment — engaging CISOs and CTOs at strategic accounts as a peer, shaping the category narrative with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms), and representing the company at industry events. This person also personally owns the technical backbone of pre-sales for the category: the Use Case Map, demo environments, POC/POV frameworks, and reference architectures that the rest of the global SE team (AMS, EMEA, APAC) builds on.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategic Field Leadership & Evangelism**

* Serve as Illumio’s foremost executive voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment, in the field and in public — conferences, webinars, analyst briefings, and published content.
* Build and maintain analyst relationships (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms) to shape how the category is defined and evaluated in the market.
* Engage CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders directly on the most strategic opportunities, drawing on firsthand operating experience to act as a peer and trusted advisor alongside regional SE leads and AEs.
* Partner with Sales and GTM leadership to shape go-to-market and revenue acceleration strategy.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Product Management to shape positioning, messaging, and roadmap priorities, informed directly by field and firsthand operator signal.

**Technical Architecture & Enablement Ownership**

* Own and continuously evolve the Use Case Map, Demo Runbook, and reference architectures used across the global SE organization.
* Personally design and build flagship demo environments and POC/POV frameworks, including integration patterns and success-criteria templates.
* Partner directly with product engineering to translate roadmap into sellable, demoable capability, and drive pre-sales enablement to sell-ready status and beyond.
* Maintain deep, current hands-on fluency with the Illumio platform — including segmentation, hybrid cloud detection and response, and broader Zero Trust architecture concepts.

**Enterprise Pre-Sales & POC Execution**

* Lead or co-lead the most strategic and complex opportunities globally, engaging directly alongside AMS, EMEA, and APAC SE teams.
* Architect and execute high-stakes POCs/POVs, including technical prerequisites, integration scoping, success-criteria definition, and executive readout.
* Act as the final technical and executive escalation point for deals across regions, ensuring a consistent, credible narrative in front of customers.

**Team Enablement & Capability Building**

* Design and deliver training curriculum and certification paths for the global SE team.
* Build battlecards, FAQs, and RFP response libraries, keeping the team current against an evolving competitive landscape.
* Mentor SE Leads and SEs on segmentation and breach containment concepts, positioning, and objection handling — bringing an operator’s perspective on how real security teams evaluate and adopt these solutions.

**Product & Market Feedback Loop**

* Serve as a structured, credible voice of the field back to Product Management on roadmap priorities, feature gaps, and competitive intelligence.
* Track and analyze the competitive landscape across microsegmentation, Zero Trust, and cloud detection and response, including new entrants and adjacent incumbents extending into the space.

**Required Qualifications**

* Prior experience as a CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security executive (VP/Director of Information Security) is required — this role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community to bring firsthand business, technical, and operational credibility to the field.
* 10+ years of experience leading enterprise security programs, with direct, hands-on exposure to network segmentation, Zero Trust architecture, incident response and breach containment, or cloud security.
* Demonstrated ability to speak credibly to both engineering and executive/board audiences translating technical risk into business terms and back again.
* Demonstrated track record as an external-facing voice: conference speaking, analyst engagement, published thought leadership, or peer-community leadership (e.g., CISO forums, ISACs).
* Proven hands-on architecture and build capability — this is not a strategy-only role; the person must be able to personally build and demo complex technical environments.
* Demonstrated experience engaging CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders, ideally as a former peer, on strategic, multi-stakeholder decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to move fluidly between deep technical detail and executive narrative.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.
* Willingness and ability to travel 30–50% for customer, analyst, and industry engagements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior title of CISO, Deputy CISO, Field CISO, or VP/Director of Information Security at an enterprise or mid-market organization.
* Direct operational experience running a segmentation, Zero Trust, or breach containment program.
* Experience with microsegmentation, CNAPP, cloud security posture management, or hybrid cloud detection and response tooling.
* Existing relationships with analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester, and others) covering network security, Zero Trust, or security operations.
* Experience integrating or building go-to-market plans around a new or acquired product line.
* Published thought leadership — blogs, whitepapers, podcasts, or conference talks — on breach containment, Zero Trust, or cyber resilience.
* Familiarity with the broader Illumio platform: Illumio Segmentation, Illumio Insights, container/Kubernetes segmentation, OT/ICS environments, and hybrid cloud architectures.

**Our Commitment**

Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.

Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.*

Lead the technical architecture of Data, Analytics and AI solutions for our clients, covering the full lifecycle from design to deployment:

* Full proficiency in English + 1 additional language (French, Arabic, Spanish, German...).
* 6+ years of technical experience in data architecture or a closely related field.
* Proven track record in a consulting or multi-client services environment.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Proven hands-on experience designing large-scale data platforms: data lake, lakehouse, or warehouse architectures (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Azure Synapse, Redshift).
* Strong command of SQL and at least one of Python, Scala, or Spark for data processing and transformation.
* Experience with Big Data ecosystems: Hadoop, Spark, PySpark, Hive, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with streaming and real-time architectures (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming).

**AI & ML INFRASTRUCTURE**

* Proven hands-on experience with ML lifecycle tooling: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, or equivalent.
* Experience architecting MLOps pipelines: model versioning, CI/CD for ML, monitoring and drift detection.
* Exposure to GenAI and LLM integration patterns (RAG architectures, vector databases, prompt pipelines).

**DATA ENGINEERING & DEPLOYMENT**

* Proven hands-on experience with orchestration and transformation tools: Airflow, dbt, or equivalent.
* Proven hands-on experience with container technologies: Docker, Kubernetes.
* Proven hands-on experience with versioning software: Git, GitHub, GitLab.
* Proven hands-on experience deploying solutions in cloud ecosystems: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

* Knowledge of data governance frameworks: data catalogs, lineage tracking, access control, and data quality management.
* Exposure to BI and data visualization platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and semantic layer design.

**INTERPERSONAL SKILLS**

* Ability to step back, analyze complex problems, define architectural options, and drive decisions.
* Strong ability to work and collaborate with a variety of stakeholders across technical and business functions.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical architectures into clear business implications.
* High autonomy, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.

**What we offer**

* A competitive salary.
* A great working environment.
* A steep learning curve with interesting and diverse topics to work on.
* A healthy work-life balance.
* Health insurance benefits.

Title: Senior Customer Service Supervisor – Complaints & Customer Experience
Description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position: Senior Customer Service Supervisor – Complaints & Customer Experience**

**Department:** Customer Service / Operations  
**Industry:** Car Rental – UAE  
**Reporting To:** Operations Head  
**Location:** UAE

**1. Job Purpose**

To oversee and manage all customer complaints, escalations, customer feedback, and online reviews across the company's car rental operations in the UAE.

The Senior Customer Service Supervisor will be responsible for ensuring that all customer concerns received through phone calls, emails, WhatsApp, messages, social media platforms, and online review portals are properly investigated, addressed, and resolved within the defined turnaround time.

The role requires close coordination with the Operations Head and relevant departments to conduct fair case investigations, identify the root cause of complaints, prepare case studies, recommend corrective actions, and improve overall customer satisfaction and service standards.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Complaint Management & Resolution**

* Take ownership of all customer complaints and escalations received through phone calls, emails, WhatsApp, SMS, social media, and other communication channels.
* Ensure every complaint is properly registered, categorized, assigned, tracked, and closed within the agreed turnaround time.
* Handle escalated customer cases professionally, ensuring timely communication and appropriate resolution.
* Investigate complaints related to vehicle condition, breakdowns, replacement delays, delivery and collection, billing, deposits, refunds, traffic fines, Salik, accident claims, insurance, rental agreements, and customer service.
* Ensure customers receive regular updates until their concerns are fully resolved.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to avoid delays and ensure accountability.

**B. Online Reviews & Reputation Management**

* Monitor and manage customer reviews across Google Reviews and other relevant online platforms.
* Respond professionally to positive and negative customer reviews within the defined response time.
* Investigate negative reviews and coordinate with the concerned departments to establish the facts before providing a response.
* Ensure no complaint or negative review remains unattended.
* Identify recurring negative feedback and recommend improvements to the Operations Head.
* Maintain a professional brand image and improve the company's online reputation.
* Follow up with customers after successful complaint resolution and encourage genuine customer feedback.

**C. Fair Case Investigation & Case Studies**

* Conduct a fair and unbiased investigation for every escalated complaint.
* Collect supporting documents, call recordings, WhatsApp conversations, emails, rental agreements, vehicle inspection reports, photographs, invoices, and system records wherever applicable.
* Prepare a detailed case study covering:
* Customer complaint and issue summary.
* Date and time of the incident.
* Background and rental agreement details.
* Investigation findings and supporting evidence.
* Department or process involved.
* Root cause of the complaint.
* Company's responsibility, where applicable.
* Proposed resolution and corrective action.
* Discuss all major and sensitive cases with the Operations Head before concluding the matter.
* Ensure resolutions are fair, transparent, and aligned with company policies, rental agreements, and applicable UAE regulations.
* Maintain proper documentation of the final decision and customer communication.

**D. Coordination with Operations & Other Departments**

* Work closely with the Operations Head, branch managers, fleet, workshop, dispatch, delivery and collection, finance, insurance, and sales teams.
* Obtain factual feedback from concerned departments before making commitments to customers.
* Escalate cases involving financial exposure, compensation, refunds, service failures, or reputational risks to the Operations Head.
* Ensure corrective actions are implemented by the responsible departments.
* Follow up on pending actions until closure.
* Highlight operational gaps affecting customer satisfaction and recommend process improvements.

**E. Customer Communication & Service Standards**

* Ensure all customer interactions through incoming and outgoing calls, WhatsApp, emails, SMS, and online platforms are handled professionally.
* Establish consistent communication standards for the customer service team.
* Ensure customers are treated respectfully, irrespective of the nature of their complaints.
* Monitor the quality of responses and ensure accurate information is communicated.
* Handle difficult customers and high-priority escalations with professionalism.
* Ensure no incorrect commitments, unauthorized compensation, or policy deviations are communicated to customers.

**F. Reporting & Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly complaint reports.
* Maintain a complaint tracker with status, responsible department, aging, resolution, and closure remarks.
* Monitor complaint turnaround time and unresolved cases.
* Prepare monthly analysis of online ratings, negative reviews, complaint categories, and recurring issues.
* Identify departments with repeated service failures and highlight them to the Operations Head.
* Present improvement recommendations based on customer feedback and case investigation findings.

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Performance Expectation**

Complaint acknowledgement

Within 15–30 minutes during working hours

Initial investigation

Within 24 hours

Complaint resolution

Target 90% within agreed TAT

Online review response

100% within 24 hours

Critical complaint escalation

Immediate escalation

Case study preparation

100% for major and escalated cases

Customer follow-up

100% for resolved escalated cases

Complaint documentation

100% accurate and updated

Recurring complaint analysis

Monthly

Customer satisfaction

Continuous improvement in customer feedback

Pending complaint monitoring

Daily follow-up with concerned departments

**4. Authority & Escalation Matrix**

* Responsible for managing and investigating all customer complaints.
* Authorized to coordinate directly with all departments for information and resolution.
* Responsible for recommending goodwill gestures, compensation, and service recovery, subject to approval.
* Must obtain Operations Head approval before committing to financial compensation, exceptional refunds, or policy deviations.
* Must escalate serious customer disputes, legal notices, regulatory matters, safety-related complaints, and high-risk online reviews immediately.
* Responsible for presenting major case studies and obtaining management direction before closing sensitive cases.

**5. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in customer service or complaint management, preferably in the UAE car rental, automotive, or hospitality industry.
* Strong understanding of UAE car rental operations, rental agreements, insurance, deposits, refunds, fines, Salik, vehicle delivery, and customer service procedures.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Knowledge of Arabic, Hindi, or other commonly used languages in the UAE is an advantage.
* Strong complaint-handling, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to investigate cases objectively and prepare detailed reports.
* Experience managing Google Reviews and social media customer feedback.
* Good knowledge of CRM systems, Microsoft Excel, and customer service reporting.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and manage escalations independently.

**6. Overall Accountability**

The Senior Customer Service Supervisor will be accountable for ensuring that every customer complaint receives proper attention, investigation, and a fair resolution.

The position is not limited to responding to customers or managing online reviews. It requires taking ownership of the complete complaint lifecycle, identifying operational failures, conducting fair case studies, coordinating with the Operations Head, and ensuring that corrective actions are implemented to prevent similar issues from recurring.

**The ultimate objective is to protect the company's reputation, improve customer satisfaction, reduce recurring complaints, and establish accountability across all operational departments.**

Title: Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)
Description:
**Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)**

**Platform & Reliability Engineering**

Location:
**Dubai, UAE**

**Engineering**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building one of the region's most ambitious e-commerce platforms: high-traffic, multi-region, and engineered for scale. Our platform — around fifteen backend services, a web storefront and native mobile apps — handles thousands of orders every day, and every one of them depends on infrastructure that is fast, observable, and always on.

*This is a founding role for our DevOps & SRE function. You will move our platform off a managed commerce PaaS onto infrastructure we own, set the reliability bar for every engineering squad, and build the team that keeps it there.*

**ABOUT THE FUNCTION**

DevOps & SRE sits at the centre of Lulu's e-commerce engineering. We own the platform every squad ships on: cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data stores, networking, security and observability. We run on-call and incident response, define SLOs with product squads, and make sure peak sales events are boring. Over the next 12–18 months our biggest goal is migrating our workloads from a vendor-managed platform onto our own cloud footprint. We are deliberately keeping the team lean and AI-first: we expect AI agents and assistants to take on a large share of the toil — writing infrastructure-as-code and pipelines, triaging alerts, drafting runbooks and postmortems — so a small team can run a large platform.

**Core ownership:**
Cloud infrastructure & Kubernetes, CI/CD & release engineering, observability stack, data-store operations, on-call & incident management, platform migration

**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON**

* Lead the migration of our e-commerce platform from a vendor-managed PaaS onto our own cloud infrastructure: discovery, target architecture, migration waves, cutover and decommissioning
* Design and run production Kubernetes for ~15 Python/Django services (DRF, Celery workers and beat), a Next.js storefront and supporting APIs, with Helm and GitOps-based delivery
* Operate and scale the stateful core of the platform: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch — HA, backups, point-in-time recovery, upgrades and capacity planning
* Build an open-source observability stack across metrics, logs, traces and profiles (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) that every squad uses day to day
* Define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with product squads for checkout, order management, delivery promise and storefront APIs, and alert on what customers actually feel
* Modernise CI/CD on Bitbucket Pipelines: build and release standards, progressive delivery (canary, blue-green), automated rollbacks and idempotent release scripts
* Codify everything as infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including networking, IAM, secrets management and environment provisioning
* Prepare the platform for peak events — load testing, autoscaling, capacity reviews and game days — so sale days run without incident
* Run incident response and blameless postmortems, and drive the reliability fixes that come out of them
* Own cloud cost visibility and optimisation (FinOps), making sure we spend where it buys reliability or speed

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Scope & Impact**

* Own multi-quarter, multi-team infrastructure and reliability goals, with the migration programme as the headline deliverable
* Make independent technical decisions on open-ended problems — build vs buy, managed vs self-hosted, which tool and when — grounded in business context and cost
* Drive cross-team initiatives across backend, frontend, mobile and data squads, optimising for the platform as a whole rather than any one team

**Technical Craft**

* Design infrastructure that meets its reliability, security and cost objectives and stays simple enough for a small team to run
* Debug non-deterministic production issues across the stack — kernel, network, container runtime, database, application — that escape less experienced engineers
* Automate toil relentlessly; treat runbooks, dashboards and alerts as code that is reviewed, versioned and tested
* Identify and retire technical risk early: single points of failure, untested backups, unpatched dependencies, end-of-life runtimes
* Champion an AI-first engineering culture — use AI tools and assistants to speed up infrastructure work, incident analysis and documentation

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Build the DevOps & SRE function: define its charter, roadmap and operating model, and how it works with product squads (platform-as-a-product, paved roads, self-service)
* Hire, coach and grow DevOps and SRE engineers; set the hiring bar and run interview loops for the function
* Keep the team lean by design — build automation and AI-assisted workflows that let a small team operate the whole platform, and measure the efficiency gains they deliver
* Design a sustainable on-call rotation with clear escalation paths, severity levels, incident command roles and stakeholder communication
* Establish reliability practices across engineering: SLO reviews, production-readiness reviews, postmortem culture, change management and DR drills
* Measure and report engineering health with DORA metrics, SLO attainment and cost dashboards; present them to engineering and business leadership
* Manage vendor relationships and infrastructure budget, and make the case for investment with data
* Act as a Culture Leader — partner with engineering leadership to set the tone, foster psychological safety and champion inclusive practices

**MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These are non-negotiable. We need engineers who can hit the ground running with our stack and ways of working.

* 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading or acting as technical lead for an infrastructure or reliability team
* Expert-level Kubernetes in production — cluster design, networking, ingress, autoscaling (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler), upgrades and troubleshooting
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable): VPC design, IAM, load balancing, managed databases and cost optimisation
* Strong infrastructure-as-code with Terraform or OpenTofu, plus Helm and a GitOps tool (Argo CD or Flux)
* Set up end-to-end observability and monitoring from scratch using open-source tools — metrics (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager), logs (Loki or ELK/OpenSearch), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry with Tempo or Jaeger) and error tracking (self-hosted Sentry) — covering infrastructure, Kubernetes, databases, queues and application code, with dashboards, alert routing and on-call integration that teams rely on
* Practical SRE experience: defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, symptom-based alerting, incident command and blameless postmortems
* CI/CD expertise (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) with deployment strategies such as canary and blue-green
* Strong Linux, networking (DNS, TLS, CDN, load balancers) and scripting skills in Python, Go or Bash — able to read and debug Python/Django application code
* Experience running Python web services and async workers (Celery or similar) in production, ideally in e-commerce, retail or other high-traffic consumer platforms

**NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These will set you apart and accelerate your impact, but aren't required on day one.

* Hands-on leadership of at least one production migration between cloud providers (e.g. AWS to GCP, Azure to AWS) or from a managed PaaS to self-managed infrastructure — planning, data migration, cutover and rollback
* Proven experience migrating stateful systems with minimal downtime: PostgreSQL (logical replication, CDC), Kafka (MirrorMaker 2), Elasticsearch (snapshot/restore, reindexing) and Redis
* Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes (Strimzi), PostgreSQL operators (CloudNativePG, Zalando, Patroni) and the Elastic operator (ECK)
* Long-term metrics storage and scale-out observability: Thanos, Mimir or VictoriaMetrics; continuous profiling with Pyroscope; self-hosted Sentry
* Platform security and supply chain: HashiCorp Vault or External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper, Falco, image signing and SBOMs
* Chaos engineering and load testing with LitmusChaos or Chaos Mesh, and k6 or Locust
* Cost tooling and FinOps practice: OpenCost or Kubecost, rightsizing, committed-use and spot strategies
* Building an internal developer platform or portal (e.g. Backstage) for service templates and self-service environments
* Familiarity with GCP data services (BigQuery, Pub/Sub) and supporting data-platform workloads
* Certifications such as CKA/CKS, Google Professional Cloud Architect or DevOps Engineer, or AWS DevOps Professional
* Public contributions: conference talks, technical blog posts or open-source maintainership

**TECH STACK**

**Application stack**

Python 3.9–3.12 (Django, DRF), Celery, Next.js / React, React Native

**Data stores**

PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch

**Messaging**

Kafka

**Cloud**

GCP (GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) — target for platform migration; AWS / Azure exposure valued

**Containers**

Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD

**IaC**

Terraform / OpenTofu, Ansible

**CI/CD**

Bitbucket Pipelines

**Observability**

Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry, Sentry

**Security**

Vault / External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno, WAF

**Reliability**

SLOs & error budgets, k6, Chaos Mesh, OpenCost

**OUR VALUES**

At Lulu, our values aren't wall decorations — they guide how we work, hire, and grow.

**Be Customer Obsessed —**
Every decision in service of the customer's success.

**Speak & Act Courageously —**
Challenge the status quo, take calculated risks, and advocate for new ideas.

**Take Extreme Ownership —**
Nothing is someone else's problem. Uphold excellence and accountability.

**Learn Voraciously —**
Growth mindset, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**Move with Focus & Urgency —**
Identify the highest-impact work and move fast.

**Win as One Team —**
Celebrate wins, lend a hand, and invest in each other's growth.

*We believe great engineering is about judgment, ownership, and craft — not just code.*

*If that resonates, we would love to hear from you.*

Description:
**Summary**

  

To support and demonstrate our NMC Nursing Mission, Vision, and Values:

**Our Nursing Vision:** At NMC Healthcare, we are committed to providing clinical excellence through safe, compassionate, and individualized care to every patient, every time.

**Our Nursing Mission:** To exemplify clinical excellence, every NMC nurse will seek to:

* Do the right thing
* Be the patient’s advocate
* Be open and transparent
* Deliver safe, compassionate care
* Recognize the uniqueness of each patient
* Contribute to an outstanding patient’s experience
* Engage with and contribute to, a learning culture
* Lead and influence changes in healthcare

**Our Nursing Values:** We will achieve this through our core values:

* Safety
* Excellence
* Ethics
* Trust
* Collaboration

The post holder will work collaboratively with other team members, uphold and live the NMC Nursing Strategy in order to provide safe and outstanding care to their patient, to the patient’s bystanders all the time, every time.

  

**Key Accountabilities**

  

These must be upheld in accordance with the Code of Conduct, Scope of Practice, and licensure as per the regulator.

**The post holder will:**

* Always speak up if safety is a concern
* Treat all patients with kindness, respect and compassion.
* Recognize and work within the limits of their own competence
* Take responsibility for their own actions
* Communicate effectively with colleagues to ensure patients receives the safest, most effective care possible.
* Perform additional duties when required

**Education and Training:**

* Ensure relevant training and competency is undertaken to deliver care safely
* Maintain up-to-date mandatory training requirements.
* Follow and comply with the NMC Nurse Competency Matrix / Framework, relevant to their role profile **.**
* Be willing to learn new clinical skills and actively contribute to the learning culture through attendance of journal clubs and professional development programs.
* Support and supervise pre-registration and new nurses and other health care workers when required.
* Participate in teaching, mentorship and preceptorship when required.
* Participate in clinical supervision of student nurses, newly graduated nurses, newly hired experienced nurses, return to practice nurses and nurses undergoing cross-training or upskilling.
* Participate in Performance Improvement Plans when required.
* Share knowledge and skill with others, to improve patient care and services.
* Ensure they are skilled, trained and competent before using any medical device.
* Involve patients in their own healthcare and recovery through education, awareness and positive reinforcement.

**Quality Assurance and Governance:**

* Speak up, if something isn't right.
* Maintain awareness of and comply with, the NMC Policies and Procedures
* Participate in all activities related to DOH/DHA/MOH/MOHAP and NMC Quality Improvement when required.
* Uphold the regulatory and accreditation standards.
* Continually seek to improve the service of and care delivery for patients and their families.
* Report and notify all untoward/serious and near miss incidents to your direct line manager and then through the incident reporting system in a timely manner.
* Cooperate with all investigations and audits when requested to do so in the interest of developing a learning culture and seeking to improve care and services.
* Promote customer service based on NMC patient satisfaction results.
* Share best practices and quality patient outcomes through audit.
* Be aware of the impact of nursing care on patient outcomes measured through Nursing Sensitive Key Performance Indicators and external benchmarks.
* Contribute to a positive practice environment, upholding the six standards of ANCC Pathway to Excellence®.

**Professional:**

* Uphold the reputation of the nursing profession at all times
* Act as a positive role model for all nursing and support staff
* Must have insight of own behaviour and in others.
* Be responsible for the assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programmes of care under the indirect supervision of senior nursing staff.
* Comply will all aspects of the UAE Code of Conduct, Scope of Practice and licensure as per the regulator.
* Refuse to undertake any task for which he/she has not been trained and is not competent to undertake.
* Always seek expert help when the demand of care, service or skill, falls outside their capabilities.
* Only delegate tasks to those team members who are trained, skilled and competent to undertake such tasks.
* Assist in updating clinical policies and guidelines in line with skill and experience.
* Assist, engage with and contribute to the professional development of colleagues.
* Ensure re-licensure is managed in a timely manner.
* Always maintain patient confidentiality.
* Ensure timely expert advice or senior nursing support is sought when a patient's condition fails to respond to prescribed treatment.
* Manage a deteriorating patient without delay, using the Early Warning System escalation process and American Heart Association emergency algorithms.
* Empower all registered nurses to be involved in shared professional decision-making and collective leadership within their work areas.
* Enabling nursing excellence, instilling a strong sense of professional pride and offers proven strategies to help ensure that the care that are delivered to our patients and populations is of the highest calibre.

**Equality and Diversity:**

* The post holder is required to promote diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging in service delivery and employment practices. All employees must comply with NMC equality and diversity policies, procedures and initiatives.

**Infection Prevention and Control (IPC):**

* IPC is everyone’s responsibility. All staff are required to read and implement the NMC IPC Policy and Strategy in an effort to maintain the highest possible standards of cleanliness at all times, thus reducing the risk of infection in patients, staff and visitors.
* The strictest hand hygiene compliance encompassing, 5 moments of hand hygiene, bare below the elbows and environmental care, will be expected of all staff, including the post holder, at all times.

**Safeguarding Children:**

* NMC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all children and vulnerable adults and expects all employees to share this commitment.
* Please refer to Federal Law No. 3 of 2016 (Wadeema’s Law)

  **https://www.khda.gov.ae/CMS/WebParts/TextEditor/Documents/Children\_Law\_English.pdf**

* Use of appropriate personal protective equipment and safety systems.
* Be familiar with emergency and evacuation procedures
* Not willfully or recklessly endanger anyone’s health and safety
* Assist with the preparation of risk assessments
* Report OSH Hazards, incidents, Near misses and issues
* Reduce, Reuse, Recycling of waste as much as possible
* Attend all OSH Trainings, awareness programs and mock drills.
* Participates in the OSHMS audits, inspections, ensuring standards are maintained
