* As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1-year probationary period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. Upon completion of your probationary period your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

### **Qualifications**

In order to qualify, you must meet the eligibility and qualifications requirements as defined below by the closing date of the announcement. For more information on the qualifications for this position, visit the Office of Personnel Management's General Schedule Qualification Standards.
  
  
Your application and resume must clearly show that you possess the experience requirements. Transcripts must be provided for qualifications based on education. Provide course descriptions as necessary.
  
  
**Specialized Experience Requirement:**
  
  
For the Telecommunications Specialist GS-0391-13: You must have one year specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 in the Federal service. Specialized experience is defined as the majority of the following:

* Managing a national or multi-regional Land Mobile Radio (LMR) program by developing strategic plans, establishing program priorities, and overseeing lifecycle management activities for mission-critical communications systems.

* Leading acquisition and procurement activities for communications equipment, systems, and services, including development of technical requirements, statements of work, acquisition strategies, and technical evaluations.

* Overseeing communications-related contracts and agreements by providing technical direction, monitoring contractor performance, and ensuring compliance with Federal acquisition regulations and agency requirements.

* Serving as the primary liaison with Law Enforcement and Investigations (LE&I) organizations, providing program leadership, technical guidance, and coordination of communications requirements supporting law enforcement operations.

* Developing, implementing, and evaluating communications policies, standards, procedures, and governance affecting agency-wide or nationwide communications programs.

* Developing, implementing, managing, or supports secure P25, encrypted, and interoperable Land Mobile Radio communications systems that support law enforcement, public safety, and multi-agency operations.

* Providing expert technical consultation and program oversight for nationwide LMR systems, including communications planning, system sustainment strategies, network requirements, and modernization initiatives supporting mission-critical law enforcement communications.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. Title: Regional Safeguarding Coordinator, East and Southern Africa Ministry Team
Description:
**We are seeking to fill (1) FT position, and the individual must be based in one of our East/Southern Africa office locations - Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Malawi, or Zambia.**

**PURPOSE**
===========

The East and Southern Africa Regional Safeguarding Coordinator supports implementation of World Renew's safeguarding suite of policies across the East and Southern Africa Ministry Team, including Kenya, Malawi, Tanzania, Uganda and Zambia, Mozambique where applicable, and countries in which World Renew may establish a disaster response presence. The position strengthens safeguarding and complaints compliance in country offices, programmes and partner organisations; supports safeguarding and complaints focal points; contributes to complaints handling and investigation processes; and advances consistent, survivor-centred practice across the region.

The role supports a unified regional safeguarding culture while responding to differences in country law, culture, language, infrastructure, service availability and programme context. Work is aligned with World Renew's Safeguarding Framework and its strategic outcomes: PREVENT, PROTECT, RESPOND, ACCOUNT and LEARN.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
=========================================

**1.****Safeguarding Policy Compliance and Risk Management**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Oversee the contextualised implementation of World Renew's safeguarding suite of policies, related procedures, standards, guidelines and tools throughout the region, including the Child Safeguarding Policy, Code of Conduct Policy, PSEAH Policy, Adults at Risk Policy, Complaints Policy and Whistleblowing Policy.
* Ensure the key requirements of safeguarding and complaints policies are communicated to staff, volunteers, contractors, country teams and relevant partner personnel.
* Advise the Regional Director, Country Directors, programme teams and focal points on safeguarding obligations, risks, compliance priorities and appropriate escalation.
* Integrate safeguarding into regional and country priorities, programme design, donor proposals, partner agreements, risk registers and monitoring processes.
* Lead or support contextual and programme-level safeguarding risk assessments and practical mitigation plans, with particular attention to high-risk programmes, partnerships and operating environments.
* Support partner due diligence, including review of safeguarding policies, governance, reporting mechanisms, referral arrangements and implementation capacity.
* Monitor emerging safeguarding risks and maintain an ESAMT safeguarding compliance register in collaboration with regional, country and global colleagues.
* Promote safe programming and dignified communications, including appropriate digital engagement, informed consent and consideration of power dynamics.

**2.****Capacity Development and Focal Point Support**
------------------------------------------------------

* Develop, adapt and deliver training and orientation materials for diverse audiences, including staff, Country Safeguarding Focal Points, Complaints Focal Points, partner staff, partner boards and leadership teams.
* Strengthen the capacity of regional and country personnel in safeguarding, PSEAH, child safeguarding, adults at risk, complaints handling, safe referrals, confidentiality and case documentation.
* Support the appointment, orientation and effectiveness of Country Safeguarding and Complaints Focal Points, with clear terms of reference and appropriate supervisory and technical support.
* Build and sustain an ESAMT network of safeguarding and complaints focal points for peer learning, shared problem-solving, case consultation and consistent practice.
* Provide ongoing advice to focal points on complaints handling generally and on specific matters when requested and authorised.
* Support partner safeguarding focal points and partner organisations to strengthen their own safeguarding systems, practices and organisational culture.
* Maintain and strengthen the coordinator's own professional capacity through relevant learning, networks and continuing development.

**3.****Safeguarding, Complaints and Feedback Systems**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Advise country and programme teams on establishing and maintaining safe, accessible, confidential and contextually appropriate complaints and feedback mechanisms, including in disaster responses outside countries of permanent presence.
* Engage communities, with support from country teams and local focal points, in the design and contextualisation of safeguarding measures and reporting mechanisms, with attention to people facing heightened vulnerability, exclusion or communication barriers.
* Promote multiple reporting channels appropriate to age, ability, language, literacy, location and access to technology, including World Renew's authorised case-management and reporting systems.
* Ensure reporting mechanisms and information are accessible and that confidentiality, informed consent, data protection and survivor safety are built into system design and operation.
* In times of disaster, provide surge support to International Disaster Response and country teams to establish or strengthen complaints and feedback mechanisms where required.
* Promote Accountability to Affected People by supporting access to relevant information, meaningful participation and safe opportunities to provide feedback.

**4.****Handling Feedback and Complaints**
------------------------------------------

* Support the handling, triage, documentation and referral of feedback and complaints received in the region through authorised reporting channels, in coordination with the Complaints Handling Committee and global safeguarding colleagues.
* Support relevant complaints-handling structures by coordinating meetings where required, preparing appropriate documentation and recommendations, and supporting communication of authorised outcomes.
* Ensure safeguarding and complaints information is accurately documented, securely maintained and accessible only to authorised personnel.
* Support country teams to refer safeguarding concerns that do not constitute a complaint against World Renew, its staff or partners to relevant authorities or specialist organisations, while protecting confidentiality and survivor safety.
* Maintain survivor-centred referral pathways and support periodic review of country-level referral mapping, including health, psychosocial, protection, legal and other relevant services.
* Promote timely review and action in accordance with approved procedures, including urgent medical referral within applicable organisational timeframes.
* Keep anonymised records of lessons, themes and precedents for organisational learning, without compromising confidentiality.
* Ensure appropriate authorised cover for complaints-handling responsibilities during periods of leave or unavailability.

**5.****Supporting Investigation Processes**
--------------------------------------------

* Support safeguarding and complaints investigations when required, in coordination with the Complaints Handling Committee and global safeguarding function, including identification of qualified investigation personnel, case preparation, logistical support and authorised presentation of findings.
* Support processes that are independent, impartial, timely, confidential and survivor-centred, and ensure real or perceived conflicts of interest are declared and managed.
* Help country teams and partners understand their obligations regarding cooperation, confidentiality, information security, non-retaliation and survivor protection without compromising investigation independence.
* Where a partner lacks investigation capacity, support access to appropriately qualified investigators in line with established procedures and agreed roles.
* Promote the safety, anonymity where applicable, welfare and psychological support of complainants, survivors, witnesses, staff, partners and investigation personnel.
* Ensure personnel involved in formal investigations can access appropriate debriefing and psychosocial support.

**6.****Accountability, Monitoring and Learning**
-------------------------------------------------

* Support safeguarding monitoring and assurance through partner reviews, programme monitoring, spot checks and regional or country visits.
* Develop and track regional safeguarding indicators, key performance measures and reporting tools in collaboration with regional and global colleagues.
* Prepare periodic regional safeguarding reports for regional, country and global leadership in accordance with agreed reporting cycles and confidentiality requirements.
* Support collection and organisation of evidence for CHS maintenance, progress reporting, reviews and audits.
* Document anonymised lessons, complaint trends, implementation challenges and promising practices to inform continuous improvement and future policy or guidance revisions.
* Contribute to global safeguarding and cross-regional CHS learning groups, sharing resources and lessons and participating in joint activities.
* Provide feedback to the global safeguarding function on regional trends, risks, capacity needs and opportunities for system improvement.

**7.****CHS and Safe Programme Quality**
----------------------------------------

* Act as a regional CHS focal point or resource person for ESAMT, as assigned, promoting awareness and practical application of the Core Humanitarian Standard among staff and partners.
* Support alignment of safeguarding practice with applicable CHS commitments, the Sphere Handbook, relevant international conventions and donor requirements.
* Support integration of safeguarding into humanitarian and community development programme quality standards throughout the programme cycle.
* Promote meaningful participation and consideration of power dynamics in programme design, implementation, monitoring and community engagement.
* Support country and programme teams to promote accessible facilities, activities, communications and safe spaces.

**8.****Internal and External Representation**
----------------------------------------------

* Support the development and functioning of country and regional communities of practice on safeguarding.
* As appropriate and alongside relevant colleagues, represent World Renew in safeguarding, PSEAH, child protection, accountability and protection networks across East and Southern Africa.
* Engage, within delegated authority, with donors, UN agencies, INGOs, local NGOs, government authorities, church networks and other relevant stakeholders on safeguarding expectations and priorities.
* Contribute to regional and global safeguarding communities of practice and help connect World Renew with relevant sector initiatives.

Title: Expert Engineer/Security Operation Centre
Description:
**Job Description**
The Subject Matter Expert – Security Operations Center (SOC) oversees advanced security monitoring and incident management activities within the Cyber Security function. This role serves as the primary escalation point for complex or high-severity security incidents, providing technical leadership and validation before handover to Incident Response teams.
  
  
The SME leads deep-dive investigations using SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, endpoint detection, and network telemetry, and applies frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and DEFEND to strengthen threat-hunting and detection coverage. The role is responsible for designing, tuning, and validating detection rules, developing and maintaining SOC playbooks and runbooks, and ensuring effective monitoring across hybrid infrastructures (on-prem, cloud, and telco cloud).
  
  
In addition, the SME mentors SOC engineers, conducts trainings and technical workshops, drives automation opportunities (SOAR playbooks and workflows), and contributes to continuous improvement of SOC processes and content. The role also monitors threat intelligence, tracks emerging threats and vulnerabilities, and communicates findings through clear reports and presentations to security leadership and stakeholders. The SME may participate in RFP processes, providing technical input to help select best-fit security solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary contact for advanced security monitoring, threat detection, and investigation methodologies.
* Lead and supervise team members to ensure effective incident detection and response.
* Provide technical guidance and escalation support to SOC analysts for complex or high-severity incidents.
* Act as the final technical validation authority before escalating to Incident Response (IR) teams.
* Utilize the MITRE ATT&CK and DEFEND frameworks to map detected threats and enhance threat-hunting capabilities.
* Lead in-depth analysis of security events from multiple sources, such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewall logs, endpoint detection tools, and network traffic data.
* Conduct deep-dive technical investigations for high-impact or ambiguous alerts.
* Identify gaps in detection coverage and recommend improvements.
* Continuously support the content development team by recommending detection rule tuning to reduce false positives and by proposing new advanced correlation rules, behavioral detections, and anomaly-based use cases.
* Develop and maintain SOC playbooks and runbooks to ensure consistent investigation standards.
* Ensure effective detection and monitoring across hybrid environments, including on-premises, cloud, and telco cloud.
* Support SOC shift staff in maintaining SLA compliance.
* Review and quality-check investigation reports before closure.
* Participate in major incident calls as the SOC technical lead.
* Conduct post-incident detection gap analysis.
* Mentor analysts and organize trainings to maintain team expertise.
* Develop knowledge articles, technical documentation, and use-case libraries.
* Lead internal technical workshops and purple-team collaboration exercises.
* Monitor and analyze threat intelligence feeds, security blogs, and industry news to stay informed on emerging threats and vulnerabilities.
* Communicate findings through detailed, high-quality reports and presentations to security teams, management, and relevant stakeholders.
* Participate in the RFP process to provide technical recommendations and propose best-fit solutions.

**Qualifications**
**Formal Education Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

**Related Professional Training, Certification Or Membership**

* Cybersecurity-related certification(s).

**Preferred**

* CISM
* CISSP
* Microsoft Sentinel training
* Splunk training

**Years & Field Of Experience Required**

* 8–10 years

**Job-Specific Competencies**

* Mandatory: Team Lead experience
* Deep experience in monitoring and interpreting SIEM outputs, including log correlation, alert triage, and threat prioritization.
* Ability to design, validate, and tune detection rules and alerts for multiple platforms (SIEM, EDR, NDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls).
* Advanced log analysis skills across endpoints, network, identity systems, and cloud environments.
* Experience with SIEM technologies such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc., EDR, and Threat Intelligence Platforms.
* Proficiency in building and executing complex queries (KQL, SPL, or vendor-specific languages) for detection and investigation.
* Expertise in identifying automation potential in SOC manual processes/workflows and designing their transformation into automated SOC/IR playbooks and modules within SOAR, such as FortiSOAR and Splunk SOAR.
* Strong knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, FTP, SMTP) and the ability to identify malicious activity patterns.
* Ability to analyze threat intelligence feeds and apply IOC/TTP indicators to operational detection logic.
* Expertise in monitoring Anti-DDoS solutions and understanding mitigation at an operational level.
* Strong capability to validate alerts and investigation outputs from SOC engineers to ensure quality and accuracy.
* Experience in documenting investigations, creating runbooks, and maintaining operational knowledge repositories.
* Understanding of the global threat landscape through analysis of cyber threat intelligence.
* Ability to mentor and coach SOC engineers on technical best practices, complex investigations, and use-case development.
* Awareness of the current threat landscape, malware trends, and attack vectors, with the ability to translate this into operational detection priorities.

Title: Technical Supervisor - Digital Delivery - Civil 3D/ Naviswork - Infra/ utilities
Description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

AECOM Middle East Infrastructure delivers civil and utility infrastructure design across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. The Digital Delivery / BIM team models and documents wet utilities, dry utilities, MEICA and smart technology networks for these projects, and is responsible for the quality, coordination and timely issue of the information that comes out of them.

**Purpose of the role**

Supervise a group of BIM team leads delivering concurrent infrastructure projects, and carry the accountability for what that group produces. On the team's responsibility assignment matrix this is the second most accountable position after the BIM Manager: it owns resource deployment, clash resolution, validation of model and drawing submissions, and the final check before anything is issued for design review.

**Key responsibilities**

**Deployment and progress**

* Own the deployment of resource across the group's disciplines, and rebalance it as project demand moves.
* Chair production progress meetings and discipline coordination meetings for the group.
* Own the key performance indicators reported for the group, and the progress position on clash and issue resolution.
* Onboard third parties brought in to support the project team.

**Delivery management**

* Own model and drawing delivery for the group, against the master information delivery plan and the discipline task information delivery plans.
* Own the standards that the work is produced to: NOC data standardisation, base plan standardisation, base plan and title block milestone requirements, and the authoring tool template files.
* Own data shortcut setup and the part catalogue or object library arranged for each project.
* Own the implementation of design automation in support of the production teams.
* Maintain the single source of truth for the 2D extraction of drawings.

**Validation and issue**

* Validate discipline model submissions against the model checklist, and BIM data for GIS submission against the GIS checklist.
* Own the drawing checklist and CAD standard compliance check.
* Perform the final drawing sanity check before anything is issued to discipline or interdisciplinary review.
* Own quantity take-off compliance where it feeds the bill of quantities.

**Clash and interface**

* Own the clash resolution activity for the group, end to end.
* Issue direction and provide the solution where a clash needs a decision.
* Agree the solution with the engineering team and establish which modeller carries the fix.
* Ensure interfaces and tie-ins between disciplines and with third parties are coordinated.

**People**

* Deliver internal training on the authoring tools, and confirm the group's capability against project requirements.
* Manage performance and development for the team leads reporting to the role.
* Support recruitment, technical interviewing and onboarding.

**Technical requirements**

* Civil 3D and AutoCAD to an advanced level, with a working command of Navisworks for clash and interface management.
* Autodesk Construction Cloud or BIM 360, including model coordination spaces and package sharing.
* ISO 19650 in practice: BIM execution plan, master and task information delivery plans, information states and level of information need.
* Data shortcuts, part catalogues, object styles and authoring templates at a level that lets the role set them for others.
* Local authority requirements in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, including utility depth, cover and corridor allocation standards.

**Qualifications and experience**

* Degree in Civil Engineering, or a diploma with equivalent proven experience.
* Ten or more years in infrastructure design production, of which at least five supervising multiple teams or a large production team in an engineering consultancy.
* Demonstrable record of delivering to ISO 19650 on live projects; formal certification is an advantage.
* Middle East consultancy experience strongly preferred.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Behaviours we are selecting for**

* Holds a standard consistently, including when programme pressure argues against it.
* Takes the decision on a clash rather than letting it circulate.
* Plans resource ahead of demand rather than reacting to a shortfall.
* Develops people deliberately, and is judged on their progression.

**How performance is measured**

* On-time issue of the group's deliverables against the agreed programme.
* Model and drawing checklist failures found after the role's own validation.
* Clash resolution rate and the ageing of open clashes in the group.
* Utilisation and bench time across the group against the deployment plan.

 **Additional Information**

*At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.* ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Produce models and drawings to the project's standards. This is the production core of the team and the largest single grade in it. **What the role is accountable for**

**Production**

* Model utility networks, corridors and surfaces in Civil 3D within the assigned scope.

* Apply the drawing checklist and CAD standard compliance check, the 2D check.
* Take part in the final drawing sanity check before the set goes to review.

**Working in the team**

* Fix the clashes assigned, and update the model rather than only the drawing.
* Contribute to quantity take-off where it feeds the bill of quantities.
* Report modelling problems and blockers to the senior technician promptly rather than working around them.

* Awareness of Navisworks and of how clashes are assigned and closed.
* Autodesk Construction Cloud or BIM 360 for filing work in the right place and state.
* Bluebeam Revu for receiving and answering markups.

**Qualifications and experience**

* Diploma in Civil Engineering or Draughtsmanship.
* Three or more years of infrastructure drafting and modelling.
* Civil 3D used on live projects is essential.

**Behaviours we are selecting for**

* Follows a standard precisely.
* Asks early when something is unclear.
* Takes correction on a drawing without taking it personally.

**How performance is measured**

* Output against allocation.
* Turnaround time on markups.
* Checklist compliance when the work is audited.

New joiners at this grade are assessed against the team's nine competency areas during onboarding, each rated Not Yet, Basic, Developing or Competent:

* Understanding project deliverables
* Authority standards and catalogues, for Abu Dhabi, Dubai and Saudi Arabia
* Civil 3D design skills, pipe and pressure networks
* Corridor and rainbow corridor modelling
* BIM standards and model management, including data shortcuts
* Design collaboration and the common data environment

They are comfortable working across business stakeholders, data engineering, software, governance, and data quality teams to clarify needs, manage requirements and delivery processes, and help lead large-scale migration work while supporting the continuity of existing data services.

**The Role**

  

As a Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration, you will serve as a primary interface between stakeholders across GM Canada and the internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams. You will translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery priorities, processes, and documentation that enable teams to maintain the existing enterprise data environment and deliver its migration to a cloud-based implementation.

This role combines business analysis, delivery coordination, and change management responsibilities. You will manage requirements and documentation, support process definition and improvement, facilitate sprint planning and backlog activities, and coordinate stakeholders through complex, interdependent work. You will play a critical role in migration planning and execution, helping teams assess impacts, manage dependencies and risks, validate outcomes, and maintain business continuity. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Act as the primary point of contact and day-to-day interface between GM Canada stakeholders and internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams.
* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, data, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and delivery priorities.
* Coordinate discovery of the existing enterprise data environment, including business processes, data flows, interfaces, dependencies, consumers, controls, and operational procedures.
* Support the ongoing operation of the legacy enterprise data environment while coordinating enhancements, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications.
* Help lead large-scale, complex migration efforts by coordinating business and technical workstreams, requirements, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing, and readiness activities.
* Work with technical teams to assess the business and operational impacts of migrating data, processes, interfaces, reports, and downstream consumers to a cloud-based environment.
* Facilitate requirements traceability from business needs through design, development, testing, release, and post-implementation validation.
* Coordinate data validation, reconciliation, business acceptance, and sign-off activities to confirm migrated data and capabilities meet business needs.
* Create, maintain, and manage project and operational documentation, including requirements, process maps, decision logs, data definitions, meeting outcomes, test scenarios, release materials, and user guidance.
* Define and improve processes, workflows, roles, and handoffs across business and technical teams, including processes for data quality, governance, issue management, and change delivery.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, demos, and retrospectives in partnership with product owners and delivery teams.
* Track progress, milestones, actions, decisions, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies; communicate status and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support data governance and data quality practices by coordinating ownership, definitions, standards, controls, issue resolution, and business approvals.
* Coordinate stakeholder engagement and change readiness, ensuring affected teams understand upcoming changes, impacts, timelines, and required actions.
* Collaborate with data architects, engineers, developers, analytics teams, product owners, and business partners to ensure proposed solutions align with business outcomes and enterprise standards.
Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery practices, documentation standards, stakeholder communications, and operational processes.  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Project Analyst, or in a similar role supporting data, software, technology, or enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience working with data platforms, data warehouses, databases, reporting, data integration, or related enterprise technology.
* Experience supporting complex technology change, migration, modernization, or transformation initiatives, including coordination across multiple teams and dependencies.
* Strong documentation skills, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, meeting outcomes, decisions, and status reporting.
* Experience supporting Agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, estimation, and delivery tracking.
* Ability to understand and communicate data flows, interfaces, system dependencies, business processes, and impacts across upstream and downstream teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify gaps, clarify ambiguity, assess impacts, and organize complex information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for business and technical audiences.
* Strong facilitation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align teams with differing priorities.
* Proficiency with collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence, or comparable tools.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and priorities.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience supporting enterprise data warehouse or data platform migrations, particularly from on-premises Oracle environments to cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud data and analytics platforms.
* Experience supporting large-scale or complex migrations involving data, ETL/ELT processes, reports, interfaces, or downstream consumers.
* Experience with data governance, data quality management, metadata, data cataloging, lineage, or master/reference data practices.
* Experience defining migration approach, scope, business impacts, dependencies, readiness criteria, and validation or reconciliation plans.
* Familiarity with SQL and the ability to review queries, data structures, mappings, and reconciliation results.
* Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, defect triage, business sign-off, and post-release validation.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed, or regulated organization with formal security, privacy, risk, or change-management practices.
Familiarity with tools such as Lucidchart, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, or equivalent requirements and process-mapping tools.  

**Compensation:**

The salary range for this role is $97,800 to $146,600. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.

Title: Project Coordinator
Description:
**Who are we?**  
Global Maritime is a leading marine, offshore, and engineering consultancy that offers intellectually stimulating work within a deeply collaborative culture and with uniquely supportive leadership. This environment creates a culture where talented professionals truly thrive. At the heart of what we do are extraordinary challenges. We directly contribute to unique, often world-first projects on the global stage. We are driven by a vibrant culture of innovation, including dedicated R&D, advanced in-house software, and the freedom to develop your own ideas. This rapid exposure across the entire spectrum of marine, offshore, and engineering consultancy accelerates your expertise like nowhere else.
  
  
**Welcoming you to our team:**  
Based in Global Maritime’s Qatar office, the Project Coordinator will report directly to the Country Manager and play a critical role within the Marine Services Department. This team supports marine operations and offshore projects by ensuring the effective engagement, coordination, and deployment of subcontractors to meet project requirements safely, efficiently, and compliantly. Working closely with clients, vendors, agents, finance teams, and operational personnel, you will be at the heart of maintaining seamless project execution through effective administration, logistics coordination, documentation management, and stakeholder engagement. This role is ideal for an organized and proactive professional who enjoys working in a dynamic marine and offshore environment and thrives on ensuring operational excellence behind the scenes.
  
  
**What does success look like in this position?**  
Success in this role means keeping subcontractor and personnel records accurate, up to date, and readily available to support uninterrupted project operations. You will confidently manage qualifications, medical certificates, visas, training records, and travel arrangements, ensuring that subcontractors are always prepared for mobilization and demobilization activities. You will proactively identify upcoming document expirations and coordinate renewals well in advance, reducing operational delays and ensuring business continuity.
  
You will build strong working relationships with clients, vendors, agents, and internal stakeholders, creating clear communication channels that enable projects to progress smoothly. Success also means efficiently coordinating visas, port passes, travel, accommodation, and logistical arrangements while maintaining cost-effective solutions that support operational objectives.
  
In this position, you will accurately process timesheets, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor documentation through NetSuite, ensuring compliance with company procedures and client requirements. You will maintain reliable filing systems, provide management with real-time workforce availability and compliance data, contribute to monthly ESG reporting requirements, and support HSEQ initiatives through equipment calibration coordination, first aid kit maintenance, and reporting activities. Your attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to operational excellence will directly contribute to the successful delivery of marine services projects.
  
  
**How you make an impact:**  
As our Project Coordinator, you will make a significant impact by ensuring that all subcontractor deployment activities are managed efficiently, compliantly, and without disruption to project delivery. You will serve as a central point of coordination for operational documentation, mobilization logistics, compliance records, and stakeholder communications, helping the Marine Services Department deliver services effectively and maintain high standards of professionalism.
  
Your contribution will strengthen the organization's ability to mobilize qualified personnel quickly and efficiently while reducing operational risks associated with documentation, travel, compliance, and contractor management. By maintaining accurate records, supporting invoice and timesheet processing, generating purchase orders, and coordinating with the finance department, you will help ensure operational transparency and financial efficiency.
  
You will also play an important role in supporting the company's HSEQ and ESG objectives through reporting activities, equipment calibration management, customer feedback tracking, and health and safety administration. Through your proactive approach, attention to detail, and strong stakeholder management skills, you will help drive operational continuity, regulatory compliance, and exceptional service delivery for clients across Qatar and the wider region.
  
  
**Your starting point when you join:**

* Bachelor’s degree and/or relevant experience within marine, offshore, crewing, logistics, project support, or subcontractor coordination environments.
* Experience working with document management systems and maintaining compliance-related personnel records.
* Strong understanding of mobilization and demobilization processes, including visas, travel arrangements, port passes, and international travel coordination.
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills with the ability to maintain databases, trackers, reports, and operational records accurately.
* Experience processing timesheets, invoices, purchase orders, and supporting finance-related administration within a structured business environment.
* Fluent written and spoken English, with Arabic language skills considered advantageous.
* Knowledge of Middle Eastern business practices and culture, preferably within Qatar or the wider Gulf region.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to liaise professionally with clients, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy.
* A confident self-starter who can work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
* To act within the powers of their role, leading by example and following GM compliance, ethics and company values.

  
**Working with us**  
Global Maritime stands out as the premier destination for any maritime professional due to our unique blend of technical opportunities – the chance to shape the industry's future on globally significant, cutting-edge projects – within a genuinely supportive and collaborative international community. This is all combined and led with leadership that actively mentors your growth within an empowering non-political environment.
  
At Global Maritime, you'll find an exceptionally supportive and collaborative environment. We cultivate close-knit global teams built on transformative relationships, not transactional ones. Expect transparent, two-way communication and a genuine sense of community, fostered through shared celebrations, activities, and a commitment to social responsibility. This ensures you feel connected, valued, and part of a cohesive international network focused on making a positive real-world impact.
  
Your journey will be guided by leaders defined by integrity, accessibility, and honest investment in your growth. You can expect clear strategic direction, open communication channels right up to the CEO, and a transparent Career Framework. You'll be mentored and developed by recognized industry thought leaders within an informal, flat structure where data drives decisions. This ensures you're empowered, supported, and valued as an individual, never just a cog in the machine.

Title: Network Operation Center Supervisor I
Description:
**Job Title:** Network Operations Center Supervisor I

**Department:** Network Operation Center

**Reports to:** Network Operations Center Manager

**Location:** On-site located in Spokane Valley, WA

**About NoaNet**

NoaNet is a non-profit mutual corporation providing telecom solutions and services and is headquartered in Spokane Valley, Washington. For over 20 years, NoaNet has operated a reliable public open-access broadband network that today totals over 3,800 fiber miles and touches every county in Washington State. Our organization provides rural areas access to broadband services, supporting more than 100 last-mile providers that serve more than 260,000 customers. NoaNet’s owner/members are nine public utility districts and a joint operating agency. Learn more about NoaNet at https://noanet.net.

**Career Overview**

Support network operations center analysts in a leadership role by leading, training, and coaching a team of network analysts to provide superior customer support relating to monitoring, troubleshooting and repairing NoaNet’s and our NCS members networks consisting of multiple systems including PON, carrier Ethernet, and MPLS. Provide technical support to clients via telephone, remote access, and on-site service; provide circuit design support by interfacing with engineering, provisioning, and customers; provide technical expertise and training to network operations analyst for troubleshooting and maintenance of the network and associated equipment, interface with installers to test and turn up new circuit orders; and other duties as assigned. Provide field support to install, maintain and troubleshoot circuits and systems and, work closely with NoaNet’s engineering and sales teams, and provide guidance and support to contract installers.

**Responsibilities**

* Supervise a team of network analyst to provide superior customer service through effective leadership, documentation, training, and coaching techniques.
* Provide exceptional customer service by possessing strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ensure NOC Analysts are properly trained and adhere to company policies associated with monitoring the network, proper call handling techniques, and best practice troubleshooting skills.
* Work closely with the field engineering and engineering teams in support of installations, provisioning, troubleshooting, and repair of the network following good engineering practices with a primary focus of network reliability.
* Install and configure network equipment for service order implementation and train network operations analysts to do the same.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and maintain a positive attitude.
* Provide telephone-based technical support to clients and customers.
* Train network operations analysts in learning NoaNet’s network architecture, equipment, troubleshooting techniques, and industry standard installation practices.
* Assist in maintaining the internal IT infrastructure of NoaNet systems.
* Assist field installers configuring the network to complete circuit order installations.
* Possess intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, and PC and server hardware.
* Possess intermediate knowledge of structured cabling.
* Possess intermediate knowledge of installation, maintenance and troubleshooting practices to install and maintain optical systems and cabling.
* Possess basic Windows and/or Linux/Unix server knowledge.
* Have ability and motivation to learn new technologies on own quickly and with minimal support and guidance.
* Demonstrate clear and professional communications both verbally and in writing.
* Have ability to read, listen to, and follow complex technical instructions, as well as research, locate, and follow written technical documentation.
* Provide direction, training, and mentoring to others.
* Work independently, organizing and setting priorities with minimal supervision.
* Be available to respond to emergencies 24/7/365.
* Seek and take advantage of opportunities for professional growth.
* Ability to install, maintain and troubleshoot MPLS, Ethernet and optical networking equipment.
* Complete and submit work orders, job tickets, time records, reports, and assignments promptly and efficiently.
* Other duties assigned.

  

**Education, Training, Knowledge, Skills and Qualifications**

* Understanding of IP/Ethernet routing and switching.
* Familiarity with Routing Protocols.
* Configuring and troubleshooting Ethernet circuits (VLANs) on a service provider network.
* Advanced knowledge of Core, Distribution, and Access layer designs and topologies.
* Familiarity with best network security practices.
* Cisco, Nokia, or similar certification or the ability to obtain the required certification within 6 months (equivalent certifications accepted).
* Knowledge and experience with process management and improvement techniques.
* Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
* Strong organizational, coordination, written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
* Strong people skills and the willingness to be accountable for results.
* Ability to set own priorities as well as manage time responsibly.
* Must have excellent customer relationship skills.
* Required – Comptia Network+ Certification.
* Desirable – ALU MPLS Certification(s) – NRS1.

  

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to perform the essential job functions, including any required physical duties, with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations will be made in accordance with applicable law.
* Maintain dress and appearance appropriate for a professional office setting.

  

**Working Conditions**

* Regularly sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk and hear.
* Frequently stand, walk and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* Regularly lift and move up to 10 lb., frequently lift and move up to 20 lb., and occasionally lift and move up to 50 lb.
* Use close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and have ability to adjust focus.

  

**Driving Requirements**

* Must maintain and possess a valid driver’s license, proof of insurance, and a satisfactory driving record.

  

**Location**

  

* On-site at Redwood Plaza located in Spokane Valley, Washington

  

**Wage**

* Wage range $32.56/hr - $46.00/hr DOE non-exempt position

* Defined Benefit Retirement Plan through the WA State Department of Retirement Systems
* 457b Optional Supplement Plan

Job Summary

Dar Al Naseej & Tansy are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented **Sales Operations Coordinator** to support and coordinate sales activities across showroom, online, hospitality, local, hypermarket, and semi-finished product sales channels. The role is responsible for managing quotations, orders, invoicing, deliveries, collections, reporting, and customer service activities while also supporting showroom sales operations and ensuring an excellent customer experience.

The successful candidate will report directly to the **Business Head** and supervise the **Heavy Driver** and **Delivery Helper**.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Operations & Administration

* Prepare quotations, sales orders, invoices, and related sales documentation in accordance with approved pricing and authorization limits.
* Process, verify, and maintain accurate sales orders and customer records.
* Coordinate with Production, Supply Chain, and Sales Teams to ensure stock availability and timely order fulfillment.
* Track order status and communicate updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate sales records and ERP system data.
* Prepare customer statements and follow up on outstanding payments.
* Compile regular sales, collections, delivery, and operational reports.

Customer Service & Sales Support

* Welcome showroom customers and provide professional product recommendations.
* Explain mattress, bedding, and related product features and benefits.
* Support the conversion of customer inquiries into sales opportunities.
* Assist with implementation of promotions and marketing campaigns.
* Conduct post-delivery follow-ups and coordinate resolution of customer concerns and feedback.

Online & Multi-Channel Sales Coordination

* Manage online sales orders and customer registration processes.
* Support hospitality, showroom, local sales, hypermarket, and semi-finished product sales operations.
* Ensure timely and accurate order processing across all sales channels.

Payment & Collection Management

* Handle showroom and online cash and electronic payments.
* Issue receipts and reconcile daily transactions.
* Coordinate the handover of collections and supporting documents to Finance.
* Monitor payment status and support collection activities.

Delivery Coordination

* Plan and coordinate delivery schedules.
* Assign daily duties to the Heavy Driver and Delivery Helper.
* Monitor delivery progress and proof-of-delivery documentation.
* Escalate delivery delays, stock shortages, pricing exceptions, and customer issues for resolution.

Qualifications

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree preferred.
* 2-4 years of experience in Sales Coordination, Sales Operations, Order Processing, or Customer Service.

* Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong administrative, reporting, and coordination skills.

Website: www.marcura.com

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**

The Towage Category Manager owns PortsDirect’s towage supplier agreements and the growth of the contracted towage network across a global supplier base. The role secures terms that are competitive for the volume PortsDirect can credibly bring, makes sure suppliers deliver the service they have agreed, and extends coverage into priority ports where no suitable agreement exists today. It is the single accountable owner of towage contract competitiveness: where an agreement fails a fair, like-for-like market comparison, the role identifies it, understands why and leads the fix.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own the commercial performance, renewal and improvement of all PortsDirect towage provider agreements.
* Build a port-by-port sourcing plan using customer demand, addressable volume, existing coverage, alternative suppliers and gaps in the network.
* Expand the contracted network into priority ports currently outside scope, concentrating on agreements that customers are likely to use.
* Negotiate pricing and terms against realistic, like-for-like volume and service requirements, assessing final customer cost (including relevant fees and charges) alongside supplier tariffs and discounts.
* Maintain evidence of market competitiveness, identify out-of-parity agreements, establish the cause and lead renegotiation or an alternative sourcing plan.
* Manage supplier relationships and performance across availability, responsiveness, service quality, invoice accuracy and compliance with agreed terms.
* Maintain accurate contract records covering terms, expiry, coverage, achievable volume, benchmarks, exceptions and corrective actions, and start renewals ahead of expiry.
* Work with Customer Success to understand why agreements are underused and remove supplier-side barriers, and share market insight with other category managers.

* Certifications: None required; a procurement qualification (e.g., CIPS) is an advantage
* 3+ years of commercial or procurement experience with a towage company or ship operator
* Towage, ship operating or port services; experience of owning a supplier category end to end preferred
* Commercial negotiation; procurement and sourcing judgement (when to renegotiate, re-source or walk away); analytical rigour; ownership and persistence; firm, constructive supplier relationship management; collaboration; able to manage a global supplier base while working remotely
* Technical skills, tools, platforms or methodologies required:
* Towage operations: the factors affecting price, capacity and service across ports.
* Procurement and sourcing: category ownership, port-by-port sourcing plans, tendering and supplier performance management.
* Commercial benchmarking: fair, like-for-like comparisons on total customer cost, allowing for service specification, port specifics and achievable volume.
* Contract management: building and maintaining a contract register and benchmarking evidence.

* Exposure to strategic, monetization, and commercial product development.
* Mentorship from experienced product and growth leaders.
* The opportunity to see the full product lifecycle, from discovery to revenue impact.
* The chance to make a measurable impact on business and customer KPIs.

The Director of Impact and Influence is a senior strategic leader and member of the Country Office Senior Management Team, responsible for driving Save the Children's impact, influence and sustainable programme development in Myanmar.
  
Reporting to the Country Director, the postholder provides strategic leadership across Programme Development and Quality (PDQ), Research, Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (RMEAL), New Business Development (NBD), Technical Excellence, and Advocacy, Campaigns, Communications and Media (ACCM).

The Toronto Transit Commission (TTC), North America's third largest transit system and recognized as one of the top places to work in the GTA has introduced its new 2024-2028 TTC Corporate Plan - Moving Toronto, Connecting Communities which continues the TTC’s legacy of delivering service to hundreds of millions of customers a year. The TTC’s new vision and mission statements also help promote the many environmental, social equity and economic benefits that the TTC provides:

  

**Vision:** Moving Toronto towards a more equitable, sustainable, and prosperous future.

  

**Mission:** To serve the needs of transit riders by providing a safe, reliable, efficient, and accessible mass public transit service through a seamless integrated network to create access to opportunity for everyone.

  

**Career Opportunity**
----------------------

Ready to help build a more resilient transit system for the future? Join the TTC and play a leading role in strengthening the organization's ability to prepare for, respond to, and recover from the growing impacts of climate change and extreme weather.

  

As the Lead, Climate Asset Resilience, you will help shape how climate resilience is embedded across TTC operations, maintenance, asset management, planning, and capital programs. This is a unique opportunity to influence organizational priorities, drive meaningful improvements, and ensure resilience actions translate into measurable outcomes that protect transit assets, infrastructure, service reliability, and customers.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

Reporting to the Manager, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, you will lead the development, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of TTC's climate asset resilience framework, ensuring climate adaptation and extreme weather preparedness are effectively integrated into asset management, operations, maintenance, and capital planning activities.

  

You will establish and maintain governance frameworks, action-tracking processes, reporting structures, performance measures, and continuous improvement mechanisms that support the implementation of TTC's Climate Adaptation Plan and related resilience initiatives. Working closely with asset owners and operational groups across the organization, you will ensure resilience actions are assigned, monitored, escalated, and completed while maintaining visibility of priorities, risks, dependencies, funding needs, implementation status, and residual risks.

  

The successful incumbent will lead and facilitate reviews following significant weather-related events, including flooding, extreme heat, severe storms, and other climate-related disruptions. You will work collaboratively with operational departments, engineering teams, Emergency Management, and external partners to assess impacts on TTC assets and infrastructure, identify recurring vulnerabilities, document lessons learned, establish corrective actions, and monitor implementation progress.

  

You will develop and maintain resilience performance metrics, dashboards, reporting systems, and centralized data repositories that track climate-related impacts on assets, infrastructure vulnerabilities, service disruptions, mitigation measures, implementation progress, and risk reduction outcomes. Through data analysis and trend monitoring, you will identify emerging risks and opportunities to improve the resilience of TTC facilities, infrastructure, and transit services.

  

A key component of the role involves working closely with Asset Management, Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Capital Planning, and Infrastructure groups to ensure climate resilience considerations are embedded into asset management plans, state-of-good-repair programs, capital investment decisions, maintenance practices, and future infrastructure planning.

  

You will also lead collaboration with external stakeholders, including municipalities, utilities, conservation authorities, Metrolinx, and other agency partners, to address climate risks and resilience opportunities affecting TTC assets and infrastructure. By fostering strong partnerships, you will help coordinate shared solutions, funding opportunities, and long-term resilience strategies that support TTC's operational and capital priorities.

  

As a trusted subject matter expert, you will provide strategic advice on climate adaptation, extreme weather impacts, infrastructure resilience, and asset vulnerability management while preparing reports, recommendations, presentations, and briefings for senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**What Qualifications Do You Bring?**
-------------------------------------

* University degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Climate Science, Asset Management, Infrastructure Management, Sustainability, Emergency Management, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
* Experience developing and implementing climate adaptation, climate resilience, asset resilience, infrastructure resilience, sustainability, risk management, or asset management programs within a large and complex organization.
* Experience conducting or supporting climate vulnerability assessments, resilience assessments, asset risk management initiatives, or climate adaptation planning activities.
* Strong knowledge of climate change impacts, extreme weather risks, asset management principles, infrastructure resilience, climate adaptation, and risk-informed decision-making.
* Experience developing governance frameworks, reporting processes, dashboards, metrics, action-tracking systems, and continuous improvement programs.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical, operational, engineering, maintenance, and asset information to identify vulnerabilities, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for resilience improvements.
* Experience working across engineering, operations, maintenance, infrastructure, capital planning, and asset management functions to advance common objectives.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, negotiation, and influencing skills with the ability to drive outcomes across multiple departments and external agencies.
* Proven ability to manage complex projects and initiatives independently while balancing multiple priorities and competing demands.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with experience preparing executive-level reports, recommendations, dashboards, briefing materials, and strategic presentations.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to develop practical and evidence-based solutions.
* Experience managing consultants, reviewing technical studies, and developing scopes of work and procurement requirements.
* Proficiency with reporting, dashboarding, data analysis, spreadsheet, database, presentation, and collaboration tools.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with demonstrated ability to manage complex assignments and meet deadlines.

  

**Assets**

* Postgraduate education in Climate Adaptation, Asset Management, Infrastructure Resilience, Sustainability, Engineering, Emergency Management, or a related field.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) designation or comparable project/program management certification.
* Professional training or certification in climate adaptation, resilience planning, asset management, sustainability, emergency management, business continuity, or risk management.
* Experience within transit, transportation, municipal government, utilities, infrastructure, or other public-sector environments.
* Experience developing climate resilience strategies for critical infrastructure, transportation systems, facilities, or large public assets.
* Experience supporting state-of-good-repair programs, asset management planning, infrastructure investment planning, or resilience-focused capital initiatives.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Commitment to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that promotes a sense of belonging, representation and reflects the needs of the communities we serve.
* A flexible, hybrid work approach that allows colleagues to find balance between their professional and personal lives and making the most of the benefits of working remotely and purpose-driven in-person collaboration opportunities.
* One of the great benefits of being a full-time TTC employee is becoming a member of TTC defined pension plan.
* A comprehensive package that covers health, dental, vision and more.
* Support for professional development opportunities for all colleagues through a broad range of learning programs that include in-person and online training, leadership development, and support for colleagues’ well-being.

**Commitment to EDI**

  

The TTC is committed to upholding the values of equity, diversity, anti-racism and inclusion in the delivery of its services and in its workplaces. The TTC is committed to fostering a diverse workforce that is representative of the communities it serves at all levels of the organization and supports an inclusive environment where diverse employee and community perspectives and experiences bring value to the organization. People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.

* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique.
